cards.why: Fish in water, birds in the air, the unborn and a cubit cut from a cloth are not allowed. A heap by sight and beans in pods are.

cards.title: Gambles and guesses
cards.ar: وذراع من ثوب وجذع في سقف وضربة القانص وبيع المزابنة - وهو بيع الثمر على رؤوس النخل بخرصه تمرا - ولا يجوز البيع بإلقاء الحجر والملامسة
cards.en: Also not allowed: a cubit from a cloth, a beam in a roof, a hunter's next catch, and muzabana: selling dates on the palm for an estimated amount of dried dates. Nor a sale by throwing a stone (whatever it lands on is sold) or by touching (whatever you touch you've bought).

cards.ask: Jamal says to a fisherman, "I'll give you £30 for whatever your next cast of the net brings up." Valid?
options: No: it is like the hunter's catch
Yes, if the price is fair
cards.source: وضربة القانص
cards.why: Selling a hunter's next catch is fasid: nobody knows what, or whether, there will be anything.

cards.ask: At a fair, you throw a stone and "buy" whatever box it lands on for £5. Valid?
options: No: the stone-throwing sale is not allowed
Yes, if you can see the boxes
cards.source: ولا يجوز البيع بإلقاء الحجر والملامسة
cards.why: A sale decided by where a stone lands is forbidden.

cards.ask: A shop sells you "one of these two hoodies, we'll decide which." Is the sale valid?
options: No: one garment of two is not allowed
Yes, they are the same price
Yes, if both are your size
cards.source: ولا يجوز بيع ثوب من ثوبين
cards.why: Selling one of two garments without fixing which is not allowed.

cards.ask: Which of these sales are fasid?

options.text: Selling with wine as the price
Selling a free person
Selling milk still in the udder
Selling a heap of rice by sight
Selling dates on the palm for estimated dried dates

source: كالبيع بالميتة أو بالدم أو بالخمر
وكذلك إذا كان غير مملوك كالحر
ولا بيع اللبن في الضرع
وبيع المزابنة
ويجوز بيع الطعام والحبوب مكايلة ومجازفة
cards.why: Wine, a free person, milk in the udder and muzabana are all fasid. Selling a heap by sight is allowed.

lessons.title: Invalid sales 2: bad conditions and vague dates

cards.title: Conditions that spoil a sale
cards.ar: ومن باع عبدا على أن يعتقه المشتري أو يدبره أو يكاتبه أو باع أمة على أن يستولدها فالبيع فاسد
cards.en: A sale with an extra condition tied to it can be fasid: for example selling a slave on condition the buyer frees him, or promises him freedom, or lets him buy his freedom.

cards.title: A condition that benefits one side
cards.ar: وكذلك لو باع عبدا على أن يستخدمه البائع شهرا أو دارا
cards.en: It is the same if the seller keeps a benefit: a slave sold on condition the seller uses his service for a month, or a house on condition the seller lives in it, or a sale on condition the buyer lends him money or gives him a gift.

cards.ask: Nabil sells his house on condition he can stay living in it for one more month. What is the sale?
options: Valid, and he stays a month
Valid, but the month is cancelled
source: وكذلك لو باع عبدا على أن يستخدمه البائع شهرا أو دارا
على أن يسكهنا
cards.why: Selling a house on condition the seller lives in it makes the sale fasid.

cards.ask: Dina sells her car for £5000 "on condition you also lend me £100." What is the sale?
options: Valid, if the loan is repaid quickly
cards.source: أو على أن يقرضه المشتري درهما أو على أن يهدي له هدية
cards.why: A sale on condition the buyer gives a loan or a gift is fasid.

cards.title: Holding back the goods
cards.ar: ومن باع عينا على أن لا يسلمها إلى رأس الشهر فالبيع فاسد ومن باع جارية إلا حملها فسد البيع
cards.en: Selling a thing on condition it won't be handed over until the start of next month is fasid. So is selling a pregnant slave woman but keeping back her unborn child.

cards.title: Buy it, then you make it
cards.ar: ومن اشترى ثوبا على أن يقطعه البائع ويخيطه قميصا أو قباء أو نعلا على أن يحذوها أو يشركها فالبيع فاسد
cards.en: Buying cloth on condition the seller cuts and sews it into a shirt or coat, or a sandal on condition he shapes it or puts straps on it, is fasid.

cards.ask: Huda buys fabric from a shop "on condition you sew it into a dress for me." What is the sale?
options: Valid if she pays for the sewing
cards.source: ومن اشترى ثوبا على أن يقطعه البائع ويخيطه قميصا أو قباء
cards.why: Buying cloth on condition the seller sews it is a fasid sale.

cards.title: Paying on a date you don't know
cards.ar: والبيع إلى النيروز والمهرجان وصوم النصارى وفطر اليهود - إذا لم يعرف المتبايعان ذلك فالبيع فاسد
cards.en: A sale with the price due at Nayruz or Mihrajan (Persian festivals), the Christians' fast or the Jews' feast is fasid if the two sides don't know when that is.

cards.title: "Pay at harvest time"
cards.ar: ولا يجوز البيع إلى الحصاد والدياس والقطاف وقدوم الحاج فإن تراضيا بإسقاط الأجل قبل أن يأخذ الناس في الحصاد والدياس وقبل قدوم الحاج جاز البيع
cards.en: A price due "at harvest", "at threshing", "at grape-picking" or "when the pilgrims return" is not allowed, since the day varies. But if both agree to drop that deadline before the harvest or the pilgrims' return, the sale becomes valid.

cards.ask: Sami buys a bike to pay "when the pilgrims come back." A week later, long before they return, both agree to drop that date. What is the sale now?
options: Valid only after the pilgrims return
cards.source: فإن تراضيا بإسقاط الأجل قبل أن يأخذ الناس في الحصاد والدياس وقبل قدوم الحاج جاز البيع
cards.why: Dropping the vague deadline by agreement before the time comes makes the sale valid.

cards.ask: Valid sale or fasid?
items: Price due on a known date
Goods held back until next month
Cloth sold on condition the seller sews it
Car sold on condition the buyer gives a gift
source: ويجوز البيع بثمن حال ومؤجل إذا كان الأجل معلوما
ولا يجوز البيع إلى الحصاد
ومن باع عينا على أن لا يسلمها إلى رأس الشهر فالبيع فاسد
أو على أن يهدي له هدية
cards.why: A known date is fine. A harvest-time price, holding back the goods, a sewing condition and a gift condition all make it fasid.

lessons.title: Invalid sales 3: what follows, and disliked sales
lessons.arabic: وكل ذلك يكره ولا يفسد به العقد

cards.title: When a fasid sale is taken
cards.ar: وإذا قبض المشتري المبيع في البيع الفاسد بأمر البائع وفي العقد عوضان كل واحد منهما مال ملك المبيع ولزمته قيمته ولكل واحد من المتعاقدين فسخه فإن باعه المشتري نفذ بيعه
cards.en: If the buyer takes the item in a fasid sale with the seller's permission, and both sides are real property (mal), he owns it but owes its value, not the agreed price. Either side may cancel. If the buyer has already sold it on, that sale goes through.

cards.ask: Ayman takes a car under a fasid sale, with the seller's permission, and sells it to Bilal. What about Bilal's purchase?
cards.source: فإن باعه المشتري نفذ بيعه
cards.why: Once the buyer owns it by taking it, his resale goes through.

cards.ask: In a fasid sale the buyer has taken the item with the seller's permission. What does he owe?
cards.source: ملك المبيع ولزمته قيمته
cards.why: He owns it but owes its value, since the agreed price came from a broken deal.

cards.title: Two things in one deal
cards.ar: ومن جمع بين حر وعبد أو شاة ذكية وميتة بطل البيع فيهما ومن جمع بين عبد ومدبر أو عبده وعبد غيره صح العقد في العبد بحصته من الثمن
cards.en: If one deal joins a free man with a slave, or a slaughtered sheep with carrion, the whole sale is void. If it joins a slave with a mudabbar, or one's own slave with someone else's, it is valid for the slave at his share of the price.

cards.ask: Kareem sells two sheep for one price: one properly slaughtered, one that died by itself. What is the sale?
cards.source: أو شاة ذكية وميتة بطل البيع فيهما
cards.why: Joining a slaughtered sheep with carrion voids the sale in both.

cards.title: Disliked, but still valid
cards.ar: ونهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن النجش وعن السوم على سوم غيره وعن تلقي الجلب وعن بيع الحاضر للبادي وعن البيع عند أذان الجمعة وكل ذلك يكره ولا يفسد به العقد
cards.en: The Prophet ﷺ forbade najsh (bidding up a price with no wish to buy), bargaining over someone else's bargain, going out to meet traders before they reach the market, a townsman selling for a desert trader, and selling at the adhan of Jumu'a. All these are makruh (disliked), but the sale is not made fasid by them.

cards.ask: Faisal sells a jacket online just as the adhan for Jumu'a is called. What is the sale?
options: Valid, and nothing wrong with it
cards.source: وعن البيع عند أذان الجمعة وكل ذلك يكره ولا يفسد به العقد
cards.why: Selling at the Jumu'a adhan is forbidden and makruh, but the sale itself still holds.

cards.ask: Fasid sale, or makruh but valid?
items: Fake bids to push up an auction price
A slaughtered sheep sold with carrion
source: عن النجش وعن السوم على سوم غيره
وكل ذلك يكره ولا يفسد به العقد
أو شاة ذكية وميتة بطل البيع فيهما
فالبيع فاسد كالبيع بالميتة أو بالدم أو بالخمر
cards.why: Najsh and bargaining over another's bargain are disliked but the sale holds. Carrion and wine spoil the sale.

cards.title: Not separating young relatives
cards.ar: ومن ملك مملوكين صغيرين أحدهما ذو رحم محرم من الآخر لم يفرق بينهما وكذلك إن كان أحدهما كبيرا والآخر صغيرا فإن فرق بينهما كره له ذلك وجاز البيع وإن كانا كبيرين فلا بأس بالتفريق بينهما
cards.en: If someone owns two young slaves who are close family to each other (a mother and child, two brothers), he must not separate them by selling one. The same if one is grown and the other young. If he does, it is makruh but the sale holds. If both are adults, there is no harm in separating them.

cards.ask: An owner sells a young slave boy away from his mother. What is the ruling?
cards.source: فإن فرق بينهما كره له ذلك وجاز البيع
cards.why: Separating a young child from close family is disliked, but the sale is still valid.

lessons.title: Cancelling a sale, and cost-plus sales

cards.title: Iqala: undoing a sale
cards.ar: الإقالة: جائزة في البيع بمثل الثمن الأول فإن شرط أقل منه أو أكثر فالشرط باطل ويرد مثل الثمن الأول
cards.en: Iqala is when both sides agree to undo a sale. It is allowed, for the same price as before. If they set a lower or higher price, that condition is void and the original price is returned.

cards.ask: Zara returns a coat, and the shop agrees to undo the sale "but we'll keep £10 of your £80." What must the shop give back?
cards.source: فإن شرط أقل منه أو أكثر فالشرط باطل ويرد مثل الثمن الأول
cards.why: In an iqala the condition of less is void; the original £80 is returned.

cards.title: What an iqala is
cards.ar: وهي فسخ في حق المتعاقدين بيع جديد في حق غيرهما في قول أبي حنيفة
cards.en: For Abu Hanifa, an iqala is a cancelling (faskh) between the two parties, but for anyone else it counts as a new sale.

cards.title: If something is lost
cards.ar: وهلاك الثمن لا يمنع صحة الإقالة وهلاك المبيع يمنع منها فإن هلك بعض المبيع جازت الإقالة في باقيه
cards.en: If the price has been lost, an iqala is still possible. If the item sold has been destroyed, there can be no iqala. If part of it is destroyed, iqala is allowed for the rest.

cards.ask: Ahmed sold ten boxes of tiles; two were smashed at the buyer's. Both now want an iqala. What can they do?
options: Undo the sale for the eight boxes left
Nothing: some of it is destroyed
cards.source: فإن هلك بعض المبيع جازت الإقالة في باقيه
cards.why: When part of the item is destroyed, iqala is allowed for what remains.

cards.title: Murabaha: cost plus profit
cards.ar: المرابحة: نقل ما ملكه بالعقد الأول بالثمن الأول مع زيادة ربح
cards.en: Murabaha is selling something for what you paid for it plus a stated profit.

cards.title: Tawliya: at cost
cards.ar: والتولية: نقل ما ملكه بالعقد الأول بالثمن الأول من غير زيادة ربح
cards.en: Tawliya is selling it for exactly what you paid, with no profit.

cards.ask: Murabaha or tawliya?
source: مع زيادة ربح
بالثمن الأول من غير زيادة ربح
cards.why: Cost plus a profit is murabaha. Exactly cost is tawliya.

cards.title: Adding costs honestly
cards.ar: ولا تصح المرابحة ولا التولية حتى يكون العوض مما له مثل ويجوز أن يضيف إلى رأس المال أجرة القصار والصباغ والطراز والفتل وأجرة حمل الطعام ولكن يقول: قام علي بكذا ولا يقول: اشتريته بكذا
cards.en: Murabaha and tawliya are only valid when the first price was something with a like (a fixed amount of money or grain). The seller may add the cost of bleaching, dyeing, embroidery, twisting thread and carrying goods. But he must say "it cost me so much", not "I bought it for so much".

cards.ask: Ilham bought cloth for £100 and paid £20 to dye it. For a cost-plus sale, what should she say?
options: "I bought it for £100" and not mention the dyeing
cards.source: ولكن يقول: قام علي بكذا ولا يقول: اشتريته بكذا
cards.why: She may add the dyeing, but must say "it cost me", since saying "I bought it for £120" would be untrue.

cards.ask: Hamid and a shop agree to undo the sale of a watch, but the money he paid has since been stolen from the till. Can there still be an iqala?
options: Yes: losing the price doesn't stop it
Only if Hamid pays again first
cards.source: وهلاك الثمن لا يمنع صحة الإقالة
cards.why: Only the item being destroyed stops an iqala. The price being lost does not.

lessons.title: Honesty, taking possession, and changing the price

cards.title: Caught overcharging
cards.ar: فإن اطلع المشتري على خيانة في المرابحة فهو بالخيار عند أبي حنيفة: إن شاء أخذه بجميع الثمن وإن شاء رده وإن اطلع على خيانة في التولية أسقطها المشتري من الثمن وقال أبو يوسف: يحط فيهما وقال محمد: لا يحط فيهما
cards.en: Khiyana is dishonesty about the cost. In a murabaha, Abu Hanifa says the buyer may keep it at the full price or return it. In a tawliya, the buyer simply knocks the overcharge off the price. Note: Abu Yusuf says the overcharge is taken off in both; Muhammad says in neither.

cards.ask: Ali sells at "cost plus £10", saying his cost was £100. The buyer learns it was really £80. In Abu Hanifa's view, what may the buyer do?
options: Keep it at the full price, or return it
cards.source: فإن اطلع المشتري على خيانة في المرابحة فهو بالخيار عند أبي حنيفة
cards.why: In a murabaha, Abu Hanifa gives the buyer the choice of full price or returning it.

cards.title: Don't sell before you have it
cards.ar: ومن اشترى شيئا مما ينقل ويحول لم يجز له بيعه حتى يقبضه ويجوز بيع العقار قبل القبض عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: لا يجوز
cards.en: Qabd is taking possession. If you buy something that can be moved, you may not sell it until you have taken it. Land and buildings may be sold before taking possession, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad says they may not.

cards.ask: Bilal orders a new phone. Before it reaches him, a friend offers him £50 more, and he wants to sell it. Can he?
options: No: he must take possession first
Yes, if the friend collects it
cards.source: ومن اشترى شيئا مما ينقل ويحول لم يجز له بيعه حتى يقبضه
cards.why: A phone is movable, so he may not sell it until he has taken it.

cards.title: Measure it again
cards.ar: ومن اشترى مكيلا مكايلة أو موزونا موازنة فاكتاله أو أتزنه ثم باعه مكايلة أو موازنة لم يجز للمشتري منه أن يبيعه ولا يأكله حتى يعيد الكيل والوزن
cards.en: If someone bought grain by measure and measured it, then sells it on by measure, the next buyer may not sell or eat it until he measures or weighs it again himself.

cards.ask: A baker buys 20 kg of flour "by weight" from a trader who had weighed it when he bought it. May the baker use it without weighing it again?
options: No: he must weigh it again
Yes: the trader already weighed it
Yes, if he trusts the trader
cards.source: لم يجز للمشتري منه أن يبيعه ولا يأكله حتى يعيد الكيل والوزن
cards.why: The second buyer must measure or weigh it again before selling or eating it.

cards.title: Adding to the price or the goods
cards.ar: ويجوز للمشتري أن يزيد البائع في الثمن ويجوز للبائع أن يزيد في المبيع ويجوز أن يحط من الثمن ويتعلق الإستحقاق بجميع ذلك
cards.en: Using the price (the money owed) before it is received is allowed. After the deal, the buyer may add to the price, the seller may add to the goods, and the seller may lower the price. All these become part of the deal.

cards.ask: After the sale, a happy seller throws in a free phone case. Is that allowed?
options: Yes: the seller may add to the goods
Only if the buyer pays for it
source: ويجوز للبائع أن يزيد في المبيع
والتصرف في الثمن قبل القبض
cards.why: Either side may add after the sale, and the seller may lower the price.

cards.title: Giving more time
cards.ar: ومن باع بثمن حال ثم أجله أجلا معلوما مؤجلا وكل دين حال إذا أجله صاحبه صار مؤجلا إلا القرض فإن تأجيله لا يصح
cards.en: If someone sells for cash now and then gives the buyer a known extra time, the price becomes deferred. Any debt due now becomes deferred when its owner gives time, except a loan (qard): giving time on a loan is not binding.

cards.ask: Noor lends Asma £100, then says "pay me in six months." Is that six-month term binding?
options: No: giving time on a loan doesn't hold
Yes, if it is written down
cards.source: إلا القرض فإن تأجيله لا يصح
cards.why: Every debt becomes deferred when its owner gives time, except a loan.

cards.ask: Which are allowed?

options.text: Selling a plot of land before taking it (Abu Hanifa)
Selling a laptop before it has reached you
The seller lowering the price after the sale
Giving a buyer three more months to pay
In a tawliya, knocking a lied-about overcharge off the price

source: ويجوز بيع العقار قبل القبض عند أبي حنيفة
لم يجز له بيعه حتى يقبضه
ويجوز أن يحط من الثمن
وكل دين حال إذا أجله صاحبه صار مؤجلا
أسقطها المشتري من الثمن
cards.why: Land may be sold before possession, the price may be lowered, a debt may be deferred, and tawliya overcharges are taken off. A movable item can't be sold before you have it.

cards.title: What riba is
cards.ar: الربا محرم كل مكيل أو موزون إذا بيع بجنسه متفاضلا
cards.en: Riba is forbidden. In a sale, riba is an excess: when something sold by measure (makil) or by weight (mawzun) is exchanged for its own kind in unequal amounts.

cards.title: The cause, and the cure
cards.ar: فإذا بيع المكيل أو الموزون بجنسه مثلا بمثل جاز البيع وإن تفاضلا لم يجز
cards.en: The cause ('illa) is being measured or weighed, together with being the same kind (jins). So measured or weighed goods swapped for their own kind must be equal: like for like is allowed, unequal is not.

cards.ask: Umar swaps 2 kg of dates for 3 kg of dates. Is that allowed?
options: No: dates for dates must be equal
Yes, if the dates differ in quality
source: أو الوزن مع الجنس
وإن تفاضلا لم يجز
cards.why: Dates for dates is the same kind and measured, so they must be like for like.

cards.title: Better quality doesn't change it
cards.ar: ولا يجوز: بيع الجيد بالرديء مما فيه
cards.en: Good quality for poor quality of the same kind is still only allowed like for like.

cards.ask: Sara offers 1 kg of top-quality Ajwa dates for 2 kg of ordinary dates. Allowed?
options: No: same kind must be equal, whatever the quality
Yes: the Ajwa are worth more
Yes, if they swap on the spot
source: ولا يجوز: بيع الجيد بالرديء مما فيه
إلا مثلا بمثل
cards.why: Quality doesn't count: dates for dates must be like for like.

cards.title: Excess and delay
cards.ar: فإذا عدم الوصفان الجنس والمعنى المضموم إليه حل التفاضل والنساء وإذا وجدوا حرم التفاضل والنساء وإذا وجد أحدهما وعدم الآخر حل التفاضل وحرم النساء
cards.en: Nasa' means delay: one side handed over later. If neither feature is there (same kind, and measure or weight), excess and delay are both allowed. If both are there, both are forbidden. If only one is there, excess is allowed but delay is not.

cards.ask: What is allowed in this swap?
into: More is fine, but no delay
items: Wheat for barley (both measured, different kinds)
More is fine, but no delay
Two shirts for one shirt (same kind, not measured or weighed)
More is fine, but no delay
source: وإذا وجدوا حرم التفاضل والنساء
وإذا وجد أحدهما وعدم الآخر حل التفاضل وحرم النساء
فإذا عدم الوصفان الجنس والمعنى المضموم إليه حل التفاضل والنساء
cards.why: Both features: equal and no delay. One feature: excess fine, no delay. Neither: anything goes.

cards.title: Fixed by the Prophet ﷺ
cards.ar: وكل شيء نص رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم على تحريم التفاضل فيه كيلا فهو مكيل أبدا وإن ترك الناس الكيل فيه مثل الحنطة والشعير والتمر والملح وكل ما نص على تحريم التفاضل فيه وزنا فهو موزون أبدا مثل الذهب والفضة وما لم ينص عليه فهو محمول عادات الناس
cards.en: What the Prophet ﷺ named as measured (wheat, barley, dates, salt) stays measured forever, even if people stop measuring it. What he named as weighed (gold, silver) stays weighed. Anything else follows people's custom.

cards.ask: Today wheat is sold in shops by the kilo, not by volume. For riba, which is it?
cards.source: فهو مكيل أبدا وإن ترك الناس الكيل فيه مثل الحنطة
cards.why: Wheat was named as measured, so it stays measured even if people stop measuring it.

cards.title: Money needs hand to hand
cards.ar: وما سواه مما فيه الربا يعتبر فيه التعيين ولا يعتبر فيه التقابض ولا يجوز بيع الحنطة بالدقيق ولا بالسويق
cards.en: In sarf (money for money: gold and silver), both sides must be taken in hand. In other riba goods it is enough that each side is specified (fixed and pointed out); taking in hand is not required. And wheat may not be sold for its flour or for sawiq (roasted barley or wheat flour).

cards.ask: Can you swap 1 kg of wheat for 1 kg of wheat flour?
options: No: wheat may not be sold for its flour
Yes, if handed over at once
source: وعقد الصرف: بما وقع على جنس الأثمان يعتبر فيه قبض عوضيه
ولا يجوز بيع الحنطة بالدقيق ولا بالسويق
cards.why: Al-Quduri says wheat may not be sold for flour or sawiq at all.

lessons.title: Riba 2: fresh and dry, oil and seed

cards.title: Meat for a live animal
cards.ar: ويجوز: بيع اللحم بالحيوان عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: لا يجوز إلا أن يكون اللحم الذي في الحيوان أقل مما هو المعقود عليه
cards.en: Meat may be sold for a live animal, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad allows it only if the meat in the animal is less than the meat being given.

cards.title: Fresh for dry
cards.ar: ويجوز: بيع الرطب بالتمر مثلا بمثل والعنب بالزبيب
cards.en: Fresh dates (rutab) may be sold for dried dates like for like, and grapes for raisins.

cards.ask: Halima swaps 1 kg of fresh dates for 1 kg of dried dates. Allowed?
options: No: fresh and dry can never be swapped
Only if there are more fresh dates
cards.source: ويجوز: بيع الرطب بالتمر مثلا بمثل
cards.why: Al-Quduri allows fresh dates for dried dates, like for like.

cards.title: Olives for oil
cards.ar: ولا يجوز بيع الزيتون بالزيت والسمسم بالشيرج حتى يكون الزيت والشيرج أكثر مما في الزيتون والسمسم فيكون الدهن بمثله والزيادة بالثجير
cards.en: Olives may not be sold for olive oil, or sesame for sesame oil, unless the oil given is more than the oil in the olives or seeds. Then oil matches oil, and the extra pays for the thujayr (the pulp left over).

cards.ask: A sack of olives holds about 2 litres of oil. Faris offers 1 litre of olive oil for the sack. Allowed?
options: No: the oil must be more than what's in the olives
Yes: olives and oil are different
Yes, if he pays on the spot
cards.source: حتى يكون الزيت والشيرج أكثر مما في الزيتون والسمسم
cards.why: The oil given must be more than the oil inside the olives, so 1 litre for 2 litres' worth is not allowed.

cards.title: Different kinds, unequal is fine
cards.ar: ويجوز بيع اللحمان المختلفة بعضها ببعض متفاضلا وكذلك ألبان البقر والغنم
cards.en: Different meats may be swapped in unequal amounts, and so may cow's milk and sheep's milk, low-grade date vinegar and grape vinegar. Bread may also be sold for wheat, or for oil, in unequal amounts.

cards.ask: Bashir swaps 2 kg of lamb for 3 kg of beef. Allowed?
options: Yes: different meats may be unequal
No: meat for meat must be equal
Only if it is the same weight
cards.source: ويجوز بيع اللحمان المختلفة بعضها ببعض متفاضلا
cards.why: Lamb and beef are different kinds, so an unequal swap is allowed.

cards.ask: Allowed or not?
items: Grapes for raisins, like for like
3 loaves of bread for 2 kg of wheat
Cow's milk for more sheep's milk
Sesame for less sesame oil than it holds
source: والعنب بالزبيب
بخل العنب ويجوز بيع الخبز بالحنطة والدهن متفاضلا
وكذلك ألبان البقر والغنم
والسمسم بالشيرج
cards.why: Grapes for raisins, bread for wheat and different milks are allowed. Sesame for less oil than it holds is not.

cards.title: Where there is no riba
cards.ar: ولا ربا بين المولى وعبده ولا بين المسلم والحربي في دار الحرب
cards.en: There is no riba between a master and his slave (what the slave has is the master's anyway), nor between a Muslim and a harbi (a non-Muslim from an enemy land) in the land of war.

cards.ask: Which of these swaps is NOT allowed?
options: 1 kg wheat for 1 kg wheat flour
Fresh dates for dried dates, like for like
source: ولا يجوز بيع الحنطة بالدقيق
بيع الرطب بالتمر مثلا بمثل
ويجوز بيع اللحمان المختلفة بعضها ببعض متفاضلا
cards.why: Wheat for flour is not allowed. Fresh for dried dates like for like, and different meats unequally, are.

cards.title: What salam is
cards.ar: السلم جائز في المكيلات والموزونات والمعدودات التي لا تتفاوت كالجوز والبيض وفي المذروعات
cards.en: Salam is paying now for goods delivered later. It is allowed in things measured, things weighed, things counted that are all alike (like walnuts and eggs), and things sold by length, like cloth.

cards.title: What can't be ordered this way
cards.ar: ولا يجوز السلم في الحيوان ولا في أطرافه ولا في الجلود عددا ولا في الحطب حزما ولا في الرطبة جرزا
cards.en: Salam is not allowed in animals or their parts, in hides by count, in firewood by bundles, or in fresh green fodder by the bunch, because these differ too much.

cards.ask: Can you pay in advance (salam) for it?
source: السلم جائز في المكيلات والموزونات والمعدودات التي لا تتفاوت كالجوز والبيض وفي المذروعات
ولا يجوز السلم في الحيوان ولا في أطرافه ولا في الجلود عددا ولا في الحطب حزما
cards.why: Measured, weighed, alike counted goods and cloth may be ordered. Animals, hides by count and firewood by bundle may not.

cards.title: Available, and later, on a known date
cards.ar: ولا يجوز السلم حتى يكون المسلم فيه موجودا من حين العقد إلى حين المحل ولا يصح السلم إلا مؤجلا ولا يجوز إلا بأجل معلوم
cards.en: The goods ordered must be available from the day of the deal to the day of delivery. Salam must be for later delivery, and the date must be known.

cards.ask: In January, Yusuf pays a farmer in advance for strawberries to be delivered in June. Strawberries can't be found anywhere between now and June. Is the salam valid?
options: No: they must be available from the deal to delivery
Yes: they will exist in June
Yes, if the farmer is reliable
cards.source: حتى يكون المسلم فيه موجودا من حين العقد إلى حين المحل
cards.why: Salam needs the goods to be available all the way from the contract to the delivery date.

cards.ask: Complete it: salam is only allowed with a ____ term.
cards.ar: ولا يجوز إلا بأجل ____
cards.source: ولا يجوز إلا بأجل معلوم
cards.why: بأجل معلوم: a known date. Short or long doesn't matter.

cards.title: Not tied to one source
cards.ar: ولا يجوز السلم بمكيال رجل بعينه ولا بذراع رجل بعينه
cards.en: Salam can't be by one particular man's measuring bowl or arm length, nor for the grain of one particular village or the fruit of one particular palm tree, since these could be lost.

cards.ask: Hana pays in advance for "the mangoes of that one tree in my neighbour's garden" next summer. Is the salam valid?
options: No: not the fruit of one particular tree
Yes, if the tree is healthy
Yes, if she names the weight
cards.source: ولا في طعام قرية بعينها ولا ثمرة نخلة بعينها
cards.why: Salam can't be tied to the fruit of a single tree or the crop of one village.

cards.title: The conditions to name
cards.ar: ولا يصح السلم عند أبي حنيفة إلا بسبع شرائط تذكر العقد: جنس معلوم ونوع معلوم وصفة معلومة وأجل معلوم ومعرفة مقدار رأس المال إذا كان مما يتعلق العقد على قدره كالمكيل والموزون والمعدود وتسمية المكان الذي يوافيه فيه إذا كان له حمل ومؤنة
cards.en: For Abu Hanifa, salam needs conditions named in the deal: a known kind (wheat), a known type (which wheat), a known quality, a known date, the amount of the capital (the money paid) when it is measured, weighed or counted, and the place of delivery when the goods are heavy to carry.

cards.ask: Which must be named in a salam?

options.text: The kind of goods
Their quality
The delivery date
The place of delivery, for heavy goods
The seller's reason for needing money

source: جنس معلوم ونوع معلوم وصفة معلومة وأجل معلوم
وتسمية المكان الذي يوافيه فيه إذا كان له حمل ومؤنة
cards.why: Kind, type, quality, date, the capital's amount and, for heavy goods, the place. The seller's reasons are not a condition.

cards.ask: Which advance order is valid?
options: 500 kg of a named wheat of a set quality, delivered on 1 June
source: السلم جائز في المكيلات
ولا يجوز السلم في الحيوان
ولا يجوز إلا بأجل معلوم
ولا ثمرة نخلة بعينها
cards.why: Measured goods with a known kind, quality and date are fine. An animal, an unknown date and one tree's fruit are not.

lessons.title: Salam 2: capital in hand, and what may be sold

cards.title: Where the two companions differ
cards.ar: وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: لا يحتاج إلى تسمية رأس المال إذا كان معنيا ولا إلى مكان التسليم ويسلمه في موضع العقد
cards.en: Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say the amount of the capital need not be named if it is pointed at, and the place of delivery need not be named: it is delivered where the deal was made.

cards.title: Pay before you part
cards.ar: ولا يصح السلم حتى يقبض رأس المال قبل أن يفارقه
cards.en: Salam is only valid if the seller receives the capital (the money paid in advance) before the two of them part.

cards.ask: Adam agrees a salam for next year's wheat harvest, and says, "I'll send you the money next week." Valid?
options: No: the capital must be paid before they part
Yes, if he pays within a week
Yes, salam is about later delivery
cards.source: ولا يصح السلم حتى يقبض رأس المال قبل أن يفارقه
cards.why: The goods come later, but the money must be handed over before they part.

cards.title: No dealing before delivery
cards.ar: ولا يجوز التصرف في رأس المال ولا في المسلم فيه قبل قبض ولا تجوز الشركة ولا التولية في المسلم فيه قبل قبضه
cards.en: Neither the capital nor the ordered goods may be dealt with before they are received. Nor may the buyer take a partner in the ordered goods, or pass them on at cost, before receiving them.

cards.ask: Bilal paid in advance for 100 kg of rice due in March. In February he sells that rice to Omar. Allowed?
options: No: not before he receives it
cards.source: ولا في المسلم فيه قبل قبض
cards.why: The ordered goods can't be dealt with before they are received.

cards.title: Cloth, gems, bricks
cards.ar: ويجوز السلم في الثياب إذا سمى طولا وعرضا ورقعة ولا يجوز السلم في الجواهر ولا في الخرز ولا بأس بالسلم في اللبن والآجر إذا سمى ملبنا معلوما
cards.en: Salam in cloth is allowed when length, width and fineness are named. Not in jewels or beads. Mud bricks and fired bricks are fine if a known brick mould is named.

cards.title: The rule behind it
cards.ar: وكل ما أمكن ضبط صفته ومعرفة مقدراه جاز السلم فيه وما لا يمكن ضبط صفته ولا يعرف مقدراه لا يجوز السلم فيه
cards.en: Anything whose description can be pinned down and whose amount can be known may be ordered by salam. What can't be pinned down can't.

cards.ask: Salam allowed?
items: Cloth with length, width and fineness named
source: ويجوز السلم في الثياب إذا سمى طولا وعرضا ورقعة
ولا يجوز السلم في الجواهر ولا في الخرز
إذا سمى ملبنا معلوما
cards.why: Cloth and bricks can be described exactly. Jewels and beads can't, so no salam.

cards.title: Selling dogs, wine, silkworms
cards.ar: ويجوز بيع الكلب والفهد والسباع ولا يجوز بيع الخمر والخنزير ولا يجوز بيع دود القز إلا أن يكون مع القز ولا النحل إلا مع الكوارات
cards.en: Selling a dog, a cheetah or other beasts of prey is allowed. Wine and pigs may not be sold. Silkworms may not be sold except with their silk, nor bees except with their hives.

cards.title: Non-Muslim citizens
cards.ar: وأهل الذمة في البياعات كالمسلمين إلا في الخمر والخنزير خاصة فإن عقدهم على الخمر كعقد المسلم على العصير وعقدهم على الخنزير كعقد المسلم على الشاة
cards.en: Ahl al-dhimma (non-Muslims living under Muslim rule) follow the same rules of sale as Muslims, except for wine and pigs. For them, a deal in wine is like a Muslim's deal in grape juice, and a deal in pigs like a Muslim's deal in sheep.

cards.ask: Which of these sales may a Muslim make?
source: ويجوز بيع الكلب والفهد والسباع
ولا يجوز بيع الخمر والخنزير
ولا النحل إلا مع الكوارات
cards.why: A dog may be sold. Wine may not, and bees only with their hives.

cards.title: What sarf is
cards.ar: الصرف هو: البيع إذا كان كل واحد من العوضين من جنس الأثمان فإن باع فضة بفضة أو ذهبا بذهب لم يجز إلا مثلا بمثل وإن اختلفا في الجودة والصياغة ولا بد من قبض العوضين
cards.en: Sarf is a sale where both sides are money: gold or silver. Silver for silver, or gold for gold, must be like for like (equal weight), even if they differ in quality or craftsmanship. Both sides must be handed over before the two part.

cards.ask: Aisha wants to swap her old 20 g gold necklace for a beautifully made 18 g gold ring. Allowed?
options: No: gold for gold must be equal weight, whatever the craftsmanship
Yes: the ring's work makes up the 2 g
Yes, if handed over on the spot
cards.source: أو ذهبا بذهب لم يجز إلا مثلا بمثل وإن اختلفا في الجودة والصياغة
cards.why: Gold for gold must be equal weight. Better craftsmanship doesn't count.

cards.title: Gold for silver
cards.ar: وإذا باع الذهب بالفضة جاز التفاضل ووجب التقابض وإن افترقا في الصرف قبل قبض العوضين أو أحدهما بطل العقد
cards.en: Gold for silver may be unequal, but both must be handed over on the spot. If they part before both sides are taken, or one of them, the deal is void.

cards.ask: Imran buys 100 g of silver with 10 g of gold and says, "I'll bring the gold tomorrow." They part. What happens?
options: It's fine: gold for silver can be unequal
Valid, if he brings it tomorrow
cards.source: وإن افترقا في الصرف قبل قبض العوضين أو أحدهما بطل العقد
cards.why: Unequal is fine, but parting before both sides are taken voids the deal.

cards.title: Two more rules
cards.ar: ولا يجوز التصرف في ثمن الصرف قبل قبضه
cards.en: The money from a sarf may not be used before it is received. And gold may be sold for silver by guess (mujazafa), without weighing.

cards.ask: Can a jeweller swap a handful of silver coins for a gold bracelet without weighing either?
options: Yes: gold for silver may be by guess
cards.source: ويجوز بيع الذهب بالفضة مجازفة
cards.why: Since gold for silver may be unequal, guessing the amounts is allowed.

cards.title: A sword decorated with silver
cards.ar: ومن باع سيفا محلى بمائة درهم وحليته خمسون درهما فدفع من ثمنه خمسين جاز البيع وكان المقبوض حصة الفضة وإن لم يبين ذلك
cards.en: A sword with 50 dirhams of silver on it is sold for 100 dirhams, and the buyer pays 50. The sale holds, and the 50 paid counts for the silver, even if he didn't say so.

cards.ask: In the same sale, they part without either side handing anything over. The silver can't be removed without damaging the sword. What happens?
options: The deal is void for both the silver and the sword
Valid, because a sword isn't money
source: فإن لم يتقابضا حتى افترقا بطل العقد في الحلية والسيف إن كان لا يتخلص إلا بضرر
وإن كان يتخلص بغير ضرر جاز البيع في السيف وبطل في الحلية
cards.why: If the silver can't come off without damage, both are void. If it could, the sword's sale would hold and only the silver would fail.

cards.title: A silver vessel, part paid
cards.ar: ومن باع إناء فضة ثم افترقا وقد قبض بعض ثمنه بطل العقد فيما لم يقبض وصح فيما قبض وكان الإناء مشتركا بينهما وإن استحق بعض الإناء كان المشتري بالخيار: إن شاء أخذ الباقي بحصته من الثمن وإن شاء رده
cards.en: If a silver vessel is sold and they part when only some of the price is paid, the deal holds for the part paid and fails for the rest, so they share the vessel. If part of it turns out to belong to someone else, the buyer may keep the rest for its share of the price, or return it.

cards.ask: A silver bowl is sold, and they part after half the price is paid. What now?
options: The sale holds for half; they share the bowl
The buyer owns it and owes the rest
cards.source: بطل العقد فيما لم يقبض وصح فيما قبض وكان الإناء مشتركا بينهما
cards.why: The paid half stands and the unpaid half fails, so the bowl is shared.

cards.ask: Which of these exchanges are valid?

options.text: 10 g gold for 10 g gold, hand to hand
10 g gold for 12 g gold, hand to hand
10 g gold for 150 g silver, hand to hand
Gold for silver, the gold to follow next week

source: لم يجز إلا مثلا بمثل
وإذا باع الذهب بالفضة جاز التفاضل ووجب التقابض
cards.why: Gold for gold must be equal. Gold for silver may be unequal, but always hand to hand.

lessons.title: Currency exchange 2: mixed coins
lessons.arabic: ومن باع درهمين ودينارا بدينارين ودرهم

cards.title: A piece of silver
cards.ar: وإن باع قطعة نقرة فاستحق أخذ ما بقي بحصته
cards.en: Nuqra is a lump of silver. If one is sold and part of it turns out to belong to someone else, the buyer takes the rest for its share of the price, with no option to cancel.

cards.title: Each kind for the other kind
cards.ar: ومن باع درهمين ودينارا بدينارين ودرهم جاز البيع وجعل كل واحد من الجنسين بالجنس الآخر
cards.en: A dinar is a gold coin; a dirham is silver. Two dirhams and a dinar may be sold for two dinars and a dirham. Each kind is counted against the other kind, so no gold meets gold unequally.

cards.ask: Is it allowed to exchange 2 dirhams + 1 dinar for 2 dinars + 1 dirham, hand to hand?
options: Yes: each kind is set against the other
No: the gold amounts are unequal
cards.source: جاز البيع وجعل كل واحد من الجنسين بالجنس الآخر
cards.why: The silver is counted against the gold and the gold against the silver, so it is valid.

cards.title: Eleven for ten and a dinar
cards.ar: ومن باع أحد عشر درهما بعشرة دراهم ودينار جاز البيع وكانت العشرة بمثلها والدينار بدرهم
cards.en: Eleven dirhams may be sold for ten dirhams and a dinar: ten match ten, and the dinar is for the one extra dirham.

cards.ask: Zaid gives 11 silver dirhams and gets back 10 dirhams and 1 gold dinar. How is it counted?
options: 10 dirhams for 10, and the dinar for 1 dirham
cards.source: وكانت العشرة بمثلها والدينار بدرهم
cards.why: Ten match ten like for like, and the dinar pays for the eleventh dirham.

cards.title: Good and poor coins
cards.ar: ويجوز بيع درهمين صحيحين ودرهم غلة بدرهم صحيح ودرهمين غلة
cards.en: A ghalla dirham is a poor-quality coin that a treasury might refuse. Two good dirhams and one poor one may be swapped for one good and two poor: three for three.

cards.ask: Complete it: two good dirhams and one poor dirham, for ____ good dirham and two poor.
cards.ar: ويجوز بيع درهمين صحيحين ودرهم غلة بدرهم ____ ودرهمين غلة
cards.source: بدرهم صحيح ودرهمين غلة
cards.why: بدرهم صحيح: one good dirham with two poor, three coins for three.

cards.ask: Which exchange is NOT allowed?
options: 11 dirhams for 10 dirhams and a dinar
2 dirhams and a dinar for 2 dinars and a dirham
source: فإن باع فضة بفضة أو ذهبا بذهب لم يجز إلا مثلا بمثل
ومن باع أحد عشر درهما بعشرة دراهم ودينار جاز البيع
cards.why: Silver for silver must be equal, so 11 for 10 alone is riba. Adding the dinar, or mixing kinds, makes it valid.

lessons.title: Currency exchange 3: alloyed coins and copper fulus

cards.title: Mostly silver, mostly gold
cards.ar: وإذا كان الغالب على الدراهم الفضة فهي فضة وإن كان الغالب على الدنانير الذهب فهي ذهب ويعتبر فيهما من تحريم التفاضل ما يعتبر في الجياد وإن كان الغالب عليهما الغش فليسا في حكم الدراهم والدنانير
cards.en: Coins are often mixed with cheaper metal. If a dirham is mostly silver, it counts as silver; if a dinar is mostly gold, it counts as gold, and the like-for-like rule applies as for pure coins. If they are mostly the cheap metal, they are not treated as dirhams and dinars.

cards.ask: Coins that are mostly copper with a little silver are swapped for more of the same coins. Allowed?
options: Yes: mostly-alloy coins may be swapped unequally
No: silver for silver must be equal
source: وإن كان الغالب عليهما الغش فليسا في حكم الدراهم والدنانير
فإذا بيعت بجنسها متفاضلا جاز
cards.why: When the cheap metal is most of the coin, it isn't treated as silver, so unequal amounts are allowed.

cards.title: When a currency dies
cards.ar: ثم كسدت وترك الناس المعاملة بها بطل البيع عند أبي حنيفة وقال أبو يوسف: عليه قيمتها يوم البيع وقال محمد: عليه قيمتها آخر ما تعامل الناس بها
cards.en: If someone buys goods with such alloyed coins and then they go out of use (people stop dealing in them) before he pays, Abu Hanifa says the sale is void. Note: Abu Yusuf says he owes their value on the day of sale; Muhammad says their value on the last day people used them.

cards.title: Copper fulus
cards.ar: ويجوز البيع بالفلوس النافقة وإن لم تتعين وإن كانت كاسدة لم يجز البيع بها حتى يعينها وإذا باع بالفلوس النافقة ثم كسدت بطل البيع عند أبي حنيفة
cards.en: Fulus are copper coins. You may buy with fulus that are in circulation without pointing to particular coins. If they are out of use, you must point to the actual coins. If they go out of use after the sale, Abu Hanifa says the sale is void.

cards.ask: Yasin buys a carpet for 500 copper fulus, to pay next month. Before he pays, the government withdraws those coins and nobody uses them. For Abu Hanifa, what happens?
options: He pays in the new coins
He pays with the old coins anyway
cards.source: وإذا باع بالفلوس النافقة ثم كسدت بطل البيع عند أبي حنيفة
cards.why: When the coins of the price stop being used, Abu Hanifa holds the sale void.

cards.ask: Can you buy with old fulus that are no longer in use?
options: Only if you point to the actual coins
cards.source: وإن كانت كاسدة لم يجز البيع بها حتى يعينها
cards.why: Coins out of use only work as a price when the actual coins are pointed to.

cards.title: Half a dirham in fulus
cards.ar: ومن اشترى شيئا بنصف درهم فلوسا جاز البيع وعليه ما يباع بنصف درهم من الفلوس
cards.en: If someone buys something for "half a dirham in fulus", the sale is valid, and he pays the number of fulus that half a dirham buys.

cards.title: At the money-changer
cards.ar: ومن أعطى الصيرفي درهما وقال: أعطني بنصفه فلوسا وبنصفه نصفا إلا حبة فسد البيع في الجميع عند أبي حنيفة
cards.en: A habba is a tiny weight. If someone gives a money-changer a dirham and says "for half of it give me fulus, and for the other half a half-dirham less a habba", Abu Hanifa says the whole sale is fasid: half a dirham of silver for less silver is riba. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say the fulus part holds and only the rest fails. If he instead says "give me half a dirham in fulus and a half less a habba", it is valid: the whole dirham is for both together.

cards.ask: Ali hands a money-changer one silver dirham and says, "Give me half a dirham's worth of fulus and a half-dirham coin less a habba," naming no split. Valid?
options: Yes: the dirham is for both together
cards.source: ولو قال: أعطني نصف درهم فلوسا ونصفا إلا حبة جاز البيع وكانت الفلوس والنصف إلا حبة بدرهم
cards.why: Without splitting the dirham, the extra silver is set against the fulus, so the sale is valid.

cards.ask: Which purchase is valid?
options: Bread for "half a dirham in fulus"
A carpet for fulus that stopped being used before payment (Abu Hanifa)
Half a dirham of silver for less silver
source: ومن اشترى شيئا بنصف درهم فلوسا جاز البيع
وإذا باع بالفلوس النافقة ثم كسدت بطل البيع عند أبي حنيفة
وبنصفه نصفا إلا حبة فسد البيع في الجميع عند أبي حنيفة
cards.why: Buying for half a dirham in fulus is valid. A price in coins that died is void for Abu Hanifa, and silver for less silver is riba.

lessons.title: Making a nikah: offer, acceptance, witnesses

cards.title: Offer and acceptance
cards.ar: النكاح ينعقد بالإيجاب والقبول بلفظين يعبر بهما عن الماضي أو يعبر بأحدهما عن الماضي وبالآخر عن المستقبل مثل أن يقول: زوجتي فيقول زوجتك
cards.en: A nikah (the marriage contract) is made by an offer (ijab) and an acceptance (qabul). Both phrases can be in the past tense, like "I have married you", or one can be past and the other about the future. For example, one asks "Marry me", and the other answers "I have married you".

cards.ask: What makes a nikah? Complete it.
cards.ar: النكاح ينعقد بالإيجاب ____
cards.source: النكاح ينعقد بالإيجاب والقبول
cards.why: والقبول: a nikah is made by an offer and an acceptance.

cards.title: Two witnesses
cards.ar: ولا يعقد نكاح المسلمين إلا بحضور شاهدين حرين بالغين عاقلين مسلمين أو رجل وامرأتين
cards.en: A nikah between Muslims is only made in front of two witnesses. They must be free, adult, sane and Muslim: two men, or one man and two women.

cards.title: Even if not known as upright
cards.ar: عدولا كانوا
cards.en: The witnesses count whether or not they are known as upright ('adl) people, and even if they were once punished for qadhf (falsely accusing someone of zina, unlawful relations).

cards.ask: Yusuf and Maryam make their nikah. The only witness is Maryam's friend Hafsa, an adult Muslim woman. Is the nikah made?
options: No: one woman alone is not enough
Yes: one Muslim witness is enough
Yes, if Hafsa is known as upright
cards.source: إلا بحضور شاهدين حرين بالغين عاقلين مسلمين أو رجل وامرأتين
cards.why: The book needs two witnesses, or one man and two women. One woman alone does not make the nikah.

cards.ask: Which of these can be the witnesses of a Muslim nikah?

options.text: Two free, adult, sane Muslim men
One Muslim man and two Muslim women
Two Muslim men not known as upright
Two 10-year-old Muslim boys
One Muslim man on his own

source: شاهدين حرين بالغين عاقلين مسلمين أو رجل
عدولا كانوا
cards.why: Two adult Muslim men, or one man and two women, even if they are not known as upright. Children and a single man are not enough.

cards.title: A Muslim man marrying a dhimmi woman
cards.ar: فإن تزوج مسلم ذمية بشهادة ذميين جاز عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: لا يجوز
cards.en: A dhimmi is a Jew or Christian living under Muslim rule. If a Muslim man marries a dhimmi woman with two dhimmi witnesses, it is valid for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad says it is not valid.

cards.title: Which words make a nikah
cards.ar: وينعقد النكاح بلفظ النكاح والتزويج والتمليك والهبة والصدقة ولا ينعقد بلفظ الإجارة والإباحة
cards.en: A nikah is made with the words nikah, tazwij (marrying), tamlik (giving ownership), hiba (giving as a gift) and sadaqa (giving in charity). It is not made with the words ijara (hiring) or ibaha (allowing).

cards.ask: Does this word make a nikah?
cards.source: وينعقد النكاح بلفظ النكاح والتزويج والتمليك والهبة والصدقة ولا ينعقد بلفظ الإجارة والإباحة
cards.why: Nikah, tazwij, tamlik, hiba and sadaqa make a nikah. Ijara and ibaha do not.

cards.ask: Ali says to Zaynab's father, before two adult Muslim men, "Marry your daughter to me", and with her consent he answers "I have married her to you". Is the nikah made?
options: Yes: an offer, an acceptance and two witnesses
No: both phrases must be in the past tense
No: the word "marry" cannot make a nikah
source: أو يعبر بأحدهما عن الماضي وبالآخر عن المستقبل
ولا يعقد نكاح المسلمين إلا بحضور شاهدين
cards.why: One phrase may be about the future and the other past, and two witnesses were there, so the nikah is made.

lessons.title: Whom a man may never marry
lessons.arabic: ولا يحل للرجل أن يتزوج بأمه

cards.title: Close family by blood
cards.ar: ولا يحل للرجل أن يتزوج بأمه ولا بجداته من قبل الرجال والنساء ولا ببنته ولا ببنت ولده وإن سفلت ولا بأخته ولا ببنات أخته ولا ببنات أخيه ولا بعمته
cards.en: A man may never marry his mother, his grandmothers on his father's or mother's side, his daughter, his granddaughters however many generations down, his sister, his sister's or brother's daughters, or his father's sister.

cards.ask: Granddaughters however far... Complete it.
cards.ar: ولا ببنت ولده وإن ____
cards.source: ولا ببنت ولده وإن سفلت
cards.why: وإن سفلت: however many generations down she is, she is forbidden.

cards.title: Family through marriage
cards.ar: بخالته ولا بأم دخل بابنتها أو لم يدخل ولا ببنت امرأته التي دخل بها سواء كانت في حجره أو في حجر غيره ولا بامرأة أبيه وأجداده ولا بامرأة ابنه وبني أولاده
cards.en: Nor his mother's sister. Nor his wife's mother, whether or not the marriage was consummated (dukhul: the couple have been together as husband and wife). Nor his wife's daughter, once the marriage with her mother was consummated, whether she grew up in his home or not. Nor the wives of his father or grandfathers, or of his sons or grandsons.

cards.ask: Khalid married Huda, but they divorced before they were ever together as husband and wife. May Khalid now marry Huda's mother?
options: No: a wife's mother is forbidden either way
cards.source: ولا بأم دخل بابنتها أو لم يدخل
cards.why: A wife's mother is forbidden whether or not the marriage was consummated.

cards.ask: Khalid's divorce from Huda came before any dukhul. Huda has a daughter, Sana, from an earlier marriage. May Khalid marry Sana?
options: Yes: a wife's daughter is forbidden only after dukhul with her mother
No: a wife's daughter is always forbidden
No, because Sana grew up away from him
cards.source: ولا ببنت امرأته التي دخل بها
cards.why: The book forbids the daughter of a wife "he has been with". Here there was no dukhul, so Sana is not forbidden.

cards.title: Milk relations
cards.ar: ولا بأمه من الرضاعة
cards.en: Nor his milk-mother: a woman who breastfed him as a baby (rada'a). The book goes on to name milk-siblings too.

cards.ask: Which of these may a man never marry?

options.text: His mother's sister
His wife's mother
His father's former wife
His son's wife
His father's brother's daughter (his cousin)

source: بخالته ولا بأم دخل بابنتها أو لم يدخل
ولا بامرأة أبيه وأجداده ولا بامرأة ابنه
cards.why: His maternal aunt, his wife's mother, his father's wife and his son's wife are all named. A cousin is not in the list.

cards.ask: Forbidden to him, or not?
source: ولا بعمته
ولا بأمه من الرضاعة
ولا بأم دخل بابنتها أو لم يدخل ولا ببنت امرأته التي دخل بها
cards.why: Aunt, milk-mother and wife's mother are forbidden. The wife's daughter is forbidden only after dukhul. A cousin is not named.

cards.ask: Umar's son divorced his wife Rania. May Umar marry Rania?
options: No: a son's wife is forbidden to him
Yes, once her iddah is over
Yes, if there was no dukhul
cards.source: ولا بامرأة ابنه وبني أولاده
cards.why: The wife of his son or grandson is forbidden to him, so Umar may not marry Rania.

lessons.title: Who may not be married together

cards.title: Two sisters, or a woman and her aunt
cards.ar: ولا يجمع بين أختين بنكاح ولا بملك يمين وطئا ولا يجمع بين المرأة وبين عمتها وخالتها ولا ابنة أخيها ولا ابنة أختها
cards.en: A man may not be married to two sisters at the same time. Nor may he be married at once to a woman and her aunt (father's or mother's sister), or a woman and her niece.

cards.ask: Omar is married to Amina. May he also marry Amina's sister Safa while Amina is his wife?
options: No: two sisters may not be married together
cards.source: ولا يجمع بين أختين بنكاح
cards.why: Two sisters may never be his wives at the same time.

cards.title: The general rule
cards.ar: ولا يجمع بين امرأتين لو كانت كل واحدة منهما رجلا لم يجز له أن يتزوج بالأخرى ولا بأس أن يجمع بين امرأة وابنة زوج كان لها من قبل
cards.en: The rule: two women may not be married to one man together if, were either of them a man, he could not marry the other. But there is no harm in marrying a woman and the daughter of her former husband (from another wife) together.

cards.ask: Hassan is married to Layla. Layla's former husband has a daughter, Nour, from a different wife. May Hassan marry Nour as well?
options: No: they are like mother and daughter
No: they are like two sisters
cards.source: ولا بأس أن يجمع بين امرأة وابنة زوج كان لها من قبل
cards.why: The book says there is no harm in marrying a woman and her former husband's daughter together.

cards.ask: Which pairs may NOT be one man's wives at the same time?

options.text: Two sisters
A woman and her father's sister
A woman and her mother's sister
A woman and her brother's daughter
A woman and her former husband's daughter
Two women who are not related

source: ولا يجمع بين أختين
ولا يجمع بين المرأة وبين عمتها وخالتها ولا ابنة أخيها ولا ابنة أختها
ولا بأس أن يجمع بين امرأة وابنة زوج كان لها من قبل
cards.why: Sisters, aunt and niece may not be combined. A woman and her former husband's daughter may, and unrelated women may.

cards.title: After zina
cards.ar: ومن زنى بامرأة حرمت عليه أمها وابنتها
cards.en: If a man commits zina (unlawful relations) with a woman, her mother and her daughter become forbidden for him to marry.

cards.title: Her sister during the iddah
cards.ar: امرأته طلاقا بائنا لم يجز له أن يتزوج بأختها حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.en: If a man gives his wife a ba'in divorce (a final divorce that ends the marriage at once), he may not marry her sister until her iddah ends. The iddah is the waiting period a woman keeps after a divorce.

cards.ask: Tariq gave his wife a ba'in divorce. Her iddah has one month left. May he marry her sister now?
options: No: not until the iddah ends
Yes: a ba'in divorce ends the marriage at once
Yes, if his former wife agrees
cards.source: لم يجز له أن يتزوج بأختها حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.why: He must wait until his former wife's iddah is over before marrying her sister.

cards.title: Owner and slave
cards.ar: ولا يجوز أن يتزوج المولى أمته ولا المرأة عبدها
cards.en: In al-Quduri's time some people were enslaved. An owner (mawla) may not marry his own slave woman (ama), and a woman may not marry her own slave ('abd).

cards.ask: Which of these may a man do?
options: Marry a woman and her former husband's daughter together
Marry a woman and her niece together
Marry his ex-wife's sister during her iddah
source: ولا بأس أن يجمع بين امرأة وابنة زوج كان لها من قبل
ولا ابنة أخيها ولا ابنة أختها
حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.why: Only the woman and her former husband's daughter may be combined. Aunt and niece may not, and the sister must wait for the iddah to end.

lessons.title: People of the Book, ihram, two in one contract

cards.title: Women of the Book
cards.ar: ويجوز تزوج الكتابيات ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات ولا الوثنيات
cards.en: A Muslim man may marry a kitabiyya: a Jewish or Christian woman, from the People of the Book. He may not marry a Majusi woman (a fire-worshipper) or an idol-worshipper.

cards.title: The Sabians
cards.ar: ويجوز تزوج الصابئيات إذا كانوا يؤمنون بنبي ويقرون بكتاب وإن كانوا يعبدون الكواكب ولا كتاب لهم لم تجز مناكحتهم
cards.en: He may marry a Sabian woman if her people believe in a prophet and accept a revealed book. If they worship the stars and have no book, marrying them is not allowed.

cards.ask: Adam, a Muslim, wants to marry Sarah, a Christian woman. Is this allowed?
options: No: she must become Muslim first
Only if she is a Sabian
cards.source: ويجوز تزوج الكتابيات
cards.why: A Christian woman is from the People of the Book, so he may marry her.

cards.ask: May a Muslim man marry her?
items: A Sabian who believes in a prophet and a book
source: ويجوز تزوج الكتابيات ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات ولا الوثنيات
وإن كانوا يعبدون الكواكب ولا كتاب لهم لم تجز مناكحتهم
cards.why: Women of the Book and Sabians with a prophet and book are allowed. Majusi, idol-worshipping and bookless star-worshipping women are not.

cards.title: Nikah in ihram
cards.ar: ويجوز للمحرم والمحرمة أن يتزوجا في حال الإحرام
cards.en: Ihram is the sacred state a pilgrim enters for Hajj or Umrah. A man or woman in ihram may still marry.

cards.ask: Bilal and Zaynab are both in ihram for Umrah. Their families want to hold the nikah in Makkah before they finish. May they?
options: Yes: a nikah in ihram is allowed
No: they must leave ihram first
Only the woman may be in ihram
cards.source: ويجوز للمحرم والمحرمة أن يتزوجا في حال الإحرام
cards.why: Al-Quduri allows both the man and the woman in ihram to marry.

cards.title: Two women in one contract
cards.ar: ومن تزوج امرأتين في عقد واحد إحداهما لا يحل له نكاحها صح نكاح التي يحل له نكاحها وبطل نكاح الأخرى
cards.en: If a man marries two women in one contract and one of them is not allowed for him, the nikah with the allowed woman stands and the other is void.

cards.ask: In one contract, Yahya marries Asma, a Muslim, and Roxana, a Majusi woman. What happens?
options: Asma's nikah stands; Roxana's is void
source: صح نكاح التي يحل له نكاحها وبطل نكاح الأخرى
ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات
cards.why: A Majusi woman is not allowed for him, so only her nikah is void. Asma's stands.

cards.ask: Which word completes it?
cards.ar: ويجوز تزوج ____ ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات
cards.source: ويجوز تزوج الكتابيات ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات
cards.why: الكتابيات: women of the Book may be married; Majusi women may not.

cards.title: An adult woman's consent
cards.ar: وينعقد نكاح المرأة الحرة البالغة العاقلة برضاها وإن لم يعقد عليها ولي عند أبي حنيفة بكر كانت أو ثيبا وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: لا ينعقد إلا بولي
cards.en: A free, adult, sane woman's nikah is made by her own consent, for Abu Hanifa, even if no wali (guardian) contracts it for her. This is so whether she is a bikr (never married before) or a thayyib (married before). Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say it needs a wali.

cards.title: No forcing, and silence as a yes
cards.ar: ولا يجوز للولي إجبار البكر البالغة على النكاح وإذا استأذنها فسكتت أو ضحكت أو بكت فذلك إذن منها وإن أبت لم يزوجها
cards.en: A wali may not force an adult bikr to marry. If he asks her permission and she stays silent, laughs or cries, that is her permission. If she refuses, he may not marry her off.

cards.ask: Aisha, an adult bikr, is told by her father about a proposal from Hamza and asked if she agrees. She stays quiet. What does her silence mean?
options: He must ask her again until she speaks
cards.source: وإذا استأذنها فسكتت أو ضحكت أو بكت فذلك إذن منها
cards.why: For a bikr, silence, laughing or crying when asked counts as permission.

cards.ask: Fatima, an adult bikr, clearly says no to a proposal. Her father still wants it. May he marry her off?
options: No: if she refuses, he may not
Yes: a father can decide for a bikr
Yes, if the man is a good match
source: ولا يجوز للولي إجبار البكر البالغة على النكاح
وإن أبت لم يزوجها
cards.why: A wali cannot force an adult bikr. Her refusal stops the nikah.

cards.title: A thayyib must say it
cards.ar: وإذا استأذن الثيب فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
cards.en: When a thayyib (a woman married before) is asked, her consent must be spoken in words.

cards.ask: How does a thayyib consent? Complete it.
cards.ar: وإذا استأذن الثيب فلا بد من رضاها ____
cards.source: وإذا استأذن الثيب فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
cards.why: بالقول: in words. Silence is enough only for a bikr.

cards.ask: Khadija, a widow, is asked by her brother about a proposal. She only smiles. Has she consented?
options: No: a thayyib must agree in words
Yes, because she did not refuse
cards.source: فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
cards.why: Smiling is permission only from a bikr. A widow is a thayyib, so she must say it.

cards.title: Still counted a bikr
cards.ar: وإذا زالت بكارتها بوثبة أو حيضة أو جراح فهي في حكم الأبكار
cards.en: If a girl loses the physical sign of being a bikr through a jump, a heavy period or an injury, she is still treated as a bikr.

cards.title: If they disagree about her answer
cards.ar: وإذا قال الزوج: بلغك النكاح فسكت وقال: بل رددت فالقول قولها ولا يمين عليها ولا يستحلف في النكاح عند أبي حنيفة وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: يستحلف فيه
cards.en: If the husband says "You heard of the nikah and stayed silent" and she says "No, I refused", her word is accepted and she does not have to swear an oath. For Abu Hanifa no oath is asked for in nikah. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say an oath may be asked for.

cards.ask: Ahmad says Sumayya stayed silent when told of the nikah. Sumayya says she refused at once. Whose word is accepted?
options: Ahmad's, if he swears an oath
cards.source: فالقول قولها ولا يمين عليها
cards.why: The word is hers, and she does not have to swear.

cards.ask: Does this count as her yes?
source: فسكتت أو ضحكت أو بكت فذلك إذن منها وإن أبت لم يزوجها
فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
cards.why: For a bikr, silence, laughing or crying is a yes, and a refusal is a no. A thayyib must say it in words.

cards.ask: Which of these is true in al-Quduri's text?
options: A wali may not force an adult bikr to marry
A thayyib's silence is her consent
A woman who refuses must swear an oath
source: ولا يجوز للولي إجبار البكر البالغة على النكاح
فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
فالقول قولها ولا يمين عليها
cards.why: The wali cannot force an adult bikr. A thayyib must speak, and the woman who says she refused swears no oath.

cards.title: A child's nikah and the wali
cards.ar: ويجوز نكاح الصغير إذا زوجهما الولي بكرا كانت الصغيرة أو ثيبا والولي هو العصبة
cards.en: A wali may contract the nikah of a young boy or girl. The wali is the 'asaba: the male relatives on the father's side, such as the father, grandfather, brother and uncle.

cards.title: A choice on coming of age
cards.ar: فإن زوجهما الأب أو الجد فلا خيار لهما بعد بلوغهما وإن زوجهما غير الأب والجد فلكل واحد منهما الخيار إذا بلغ إن شاء أقام على النكاح وإن شاء فسخ
cards.en: If the father or grandfather arranged it, the two have no choice once they come of age. If anyone else arranged it, each of them has a choice on coming of age: to stay in the nikah or to end it.

cards.ask: When Hind was young, her uncle arranged her nikah. She has now come of age. What may she do?
options: Choose to stay in the nikah or end it
Only her father may now decide
cards.source: وإن زوجهما غير الأب والجد فلكل واحد منهما الخيار إذا بلغ
cards.why: An uncle is not the father or grandfather, so Hind has the choice on coming of age.

cards.title: Who cannot be a wali
cards.ar: ولا ولاية لعبد ولا صغير ولا مجنون ولا كافر على مسلمة وقال أبو حنيفة: يجوز لغير العصبات من الأقارب التزويج
cards.en: A slave, a child, an insane person, or a non-Muslim over a Muslim woman cannot be a wali. Abu Hanifa said that relatives who are not 'asaba may also arrange a nikah.

cards.ask: Who cannot be the wali of a Muslim woman?

options.text: A child
An insane person
A non-Muslim relative
A slave
Her adult Muslim brother

cards.source: ولا ولاية لعبد ولا صغير ولا مجنون ولا كافر على مسلمة
cards.why: A slave, a child, an insane person and a non-Muslim have no guardianship over a Muslim woman. Her adult Muslim brother is 'asaba.

cards.title: When the nearer wali is far away
cards.ar: ومن لا ولي لها إذا زوجها مولاها الذي أعتقها جاز وإذا غاب الولي الأقرب غيبة جاز لمن هو أبعد منه أن يزوج والغيبة المنقطعة: أن يكون في بلد لا تصل إليه القوافل في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.en: A woman with no wali may be married off by the one who freed her. If the nearer wali is far away, the next wali may arrange the nikah. "Far away" means in a land the caravans reach only once a year.

cards.ask: What is "far away"? Complete it.
cards.ar: أن يكون في بلد لا تصل إليه ____ في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.source: أن يكون في بلد لا تصل إليه القوافل في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.why: القوافل: a land the caravans reach only once a year.

cards.ask: Maryam's father lives in a far land that caravans reach only once a year. Her brother is at home. Who may arrange her nikah?
options: Her brother, as the next wali
No one until her father returns
source: وإذا غاب الولي الأقرب غيبة جاز لمن هو أبعد منه أن يزوج
لا تصل إليه القوافل في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.why: The nearer wali is far away by the book's measure, so the next wali, her brother, may arrange it.

cards.title: An insane woman's father and son
cards.ar: وإذا اجمع في المجنونة أبوها وابنها فالولي في نكاحها ابنها عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: أبوها
cards.en: If an insane woman has both a father and a son, her wali for nikah is her son, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad says her father.

cards.title: A wali marrying her himself
cards.ar: ويجوز لابن العم أن يزوج بنت عمه من نفسه وإذا أذنت المرأة لرجل أن يزوجها من نفسه فقعد بحضرة شاهدين جاز
cards.en: A cousin who is her wali may marry his uncle's daughter to himself. And if a woman permits a man to marry her to himself, and he makes the contract before two witnesses, it is valid.

cards.ask: Salma's wali is her cousin Idris, and they wish to marry. With her consent, Idris makes the nikah himself before two witnesses. Is it valid?
options: Yes: a cousin may marry her to himself
No: someone else must be her wali
No: a wali can never marry his ward
cards.source: ويجوز لابن العم أن يزوج بنت عمه من نفسه
cards.why: The book allows the cousin to marry his uncle's daughter to himself, before two witnesses.

cards.ask: Bashir's father arranged his nikah when Bashir was young. Now he is an adult. Does he have a choice to end it?
options: Yes: every child has the choice
Yes, if he asks within a year
cards.source: فإن زوجهما الأب أو الجد فلا خيار لهما بعد بلوغهما
cards.why: When the father or grandfather arranged it, there is no choice on coming of age.

cards.title: Kafa'a matters
cards.ar: والكفاءة في النكاح معتبرة فإذا تزوجت المرأة غير كفء فللأولياء أن يفرقوا بينهما
cards.en: Kafa'a means the husband being a suitable match (kufu) for the wife. It is taken into account: if a woman marries a man who is not her match, her walis may have them separated.

cards.title: In what kafa'a is measured
cards.ar: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب والدين والمال وهو: أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة وتعتبر في الصنائع
cards.en: Kafa'a looks at lineage, religion, wealth and trade. Wealth here means he can pay the mahr and the nafaqa. The mahr is the gift a husband must give his wife for the nikah; the nafaqa is her upkeep: food, clothing and home.

cards.ask: Complete it.
cards.ar: والكفاءة تعتبر في ____
cards.source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب
cards.why: النسب: lineage is the first thing al-Quduri names.

cards.ask: Which of these does kafa'a look at?

options.text: Lineage
Religion
Being able to pay the mahr and upkeep
Trade or work
Height
Which city he lives in

source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب والدين والمال
أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة وتعتبر في الصنائع
cards.why: Lineage, religion, wealth (mahr and nafaqa) and trade. Height and city are not named.

cards.ask: Zayd proposes to Ruqayya, but he has no means to pay a mahr or provide her upkeep. In wealth, is he a kufu for her?
options: No: wealth means owning the mahr and the upkeep
Yes: wealth does not matter in kafa'a
Yes, if he has a trade
cards.source: والمال وهو: أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة
cards.why: Al-Quduri defines wealth in kafa'a as owning enough for the mahr and nafaqa.

cards.ask: An adult woman marries a man who is not a kufu for her. What may her walis do?
options: Cancel it only if she was a bikr
cards.source: فإذا تزوجت المرأة غير كفء فللأولياء أن يفرقوا بينهما
cards.why: The walis may have them separated when the husband is not her match.

cards.title: A mahr below her worth
cards.ar: وإذا تزوجت المرأة ونقصت من مهرها فللأولياء الاعتراض عليها عند أبي حنيفة حتى يتم لها مهر مثلها أو يفارقها
cards.en: If a woman marries for less than her proper mahr, her walis may object, for Abu Hanifa, until the husband completes her mahr al-mithl or parts from her. Mahr al-mithl is the usual mahr of women like her in her family.

cards.ask: Asma marries for a mahr far below what the women of her family receive. Her walis object. What ends their objection?
options: The husband completes her mahr al-mithl, or they part
cards.source: حتى يتم لها مهر مثلها أو يفارقها
cards.why: The walis may object until he completes her mahr al-mithl or parts from her.

cards.title: Only a father or grandfather
cards.ar: ونقص من مهرها أو ابنه الصغير وزاد في مهر جاز ذلك عليهما ولا يجوز ذلك لغير الأب والجد
cards.en: If a father marries off his young daughter for less than her proper mahr, or his young son for more, it holds against them. No one but the father or grandfather may do this.

cards.ask: An uncle arranges his young niece's nikah for a mahr well below her mahr al-mithl. Does the lower mahr hold?
options: No: only a father or grandfather may do this
Yes: any wali may do this
Yes, if two witnesses are present
cards.source: ولا يجوز ذلك لغير الأب والجد
cards.why: Only the father or grandfather may lower a young daughter's mahr.

cards.ask: Which of these is NOT one of the things kafa'a looks at?
cards.source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب والدين والمال
cards.why: Lineage, religion, wealth and trade are named. Beauty is not part of kafa'a.

cards.title: Named or not
cards.ar: ويصح النكاح إذا سمى فيه مهرا ويصح وإن لم يسم فيه مهرا
cards.en: The nikah is valid whether or not a mahr is named in it. The mahr is the gift the husband must give his wife.

cards.title: The least mahr
cards.ar: وأقل المهر عشرة دراهم فإن سمى أقل من عشرة فلها العشرة
cards.en: The least mahr is ten dirhams (silver coins). If less than ten is named, she gets ten.

cards.ask: Complete it.
cards.ar: وأقل المهر ____ دراهم
cards.source: وأقل المهر عشرة دراهم
cards.why: عشرة: the least mahr is ten dirhams.

cards.ask: Hamid names a mahr of 6 dirhams for Zaynab. What is she owed?
cards.source: فإن سمى أقل من عشرة فلها العشرة
cards.why: Below ten, she is owed the ten.

cards.title: Full or half
cards.ar: ومن سمى مهرا عشرة فما زاد فعليه المسمى إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول والخلوة فلها نصف المسمى
cards.en: If he named ten or more, he owes all of it once the marriage is consummated (dukhul) or if he dies. If he divorces her before dukhul and before khalwa (being alone together in private), she gets half of what was named.

cards.ask: Yasin named a mahr of 1,000 dirhams, then divorced Huda before they had ever been alone together. What does she get?
cards.source: وإن طلقها قبل الدخول والخلوة فلها نصف المسمى
cards.why: Divorce before dukhul and khalwa gives her half the named mahr: 500.

cards.title: When no mahr was named
cards.ar: وإن تزوجها ولم يسم لها مهرا أو تزوجها على أن لا مهر لها فلها مهر مثلها إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول فلها المتعة وهي ثلاثة أثواب من كسوة مثلها
cards.en: If no mahr was named, or they even agreed there would be none, she gets her mahr al-mithl (the usual mahr of women like her) after dukhul or if he dies. If he divorces her before dukhul she gets the mut'a: a parting gift of three garments, the kind of clothes a woman like her wears.

cards.ask: Ibrahim married Sumayya without naming a mahr, then divorced her before dukhul. What is she owed?
cards.source: وإن طلقها قبل الدخول فلها المتعة وهي ثلاثة أثواب من كسوة مثلها
cards.why: With no mahr named and a divorce before dukhul, she is owed the mut'a of three garments.

cards.title: A forbidden thing as mahr
cards.ar: وإن تزوج المسلم على خمر أو خنزير فالنكاح جائز ولها مهر مثلها
cards.en: If a Muslim names wine or pork as the mahr, the nikah is still valid and she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.title: A mahr agreed after the nikah
cards.ar: ثم تراضيا على تسمية مهر فهو لها إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول لها المتعة
cards.en: If no mahr was named and they later agree on one, it is hers after dukhul or if he dies. If he divorces her before dukhul, she gets the mut'a.

cards.ask: What is she owed?
items: 1,000 named, divorced before dukhul and khalwa
Wine named as mahr, after dukhul
source: فعليه المسمى إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول والخلوة فلها نصف المسمى
فلها مهر مثلها إن دخل بها أو مات عنها
فالنكاح جائز ولها مهر مثلها
cards.why: A named mahr is owed in full after dukhul or death, half if divorced before. With none named, or a forbidden one, she gets mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: A mahr of 4 dirhams is named, and the husband divorces before dukhul and khalwa. What is she owed?
source: فإن سمى أقل من عشرة فلها العشرة
فلها نصف المسمى
cards.why: Less than ten counts as ten, and divorce before dukhul gives half: 5 dirhams.

cards.title: Adding to or lowering the mahr
cards.ar: وإن زادها في المهر بعد العقد لزمته الزيادة وتسقط بالطلاق قبل الدخول وإن حطت عنه من مهرها صح الحط
cards.en: If the husband adds to the mahr after the contract, he owes the extra, but it falls away if he divorces her before dukhul. If the wife lets him off part of her mahr, that is valid.

cards.ask: Musa named 1,000 dirhams, later added 200 as a kindness, then divorced his wife before dukhul. What does she get?
source: لزمته الزيادة وتسقط بالطلاق قبل الدخول
فلها نصف المسمى
cards.why: The added 200 drops with divorce before dukhul, so she gets half of 1,000.

cards.ask: Layla's mahr is 2,000 dirhams. She tells her husband she lets him off 500 of it. Does this count?
options: Yes: her lowering it is valid
No: the mahr can never be lowered
cards.source: وإن حطت عنه من مهرها صح الحط
cards.why: A wife may let her husband off part of her mahr, and it holds.

cards.title: A valid khalwa
cards.ar: وإذا خلا الزوج بامرأته
cards.en: Khalwa is husband and wife being alone together in private. If they were alone with nothing preventing them from being together as a married couple, and then he divorces her, she gets the full mahr.

cards.title: When khalwa does not count
cards.ar: وإن كان أحدهما مريضا أو صائما في رمضان أو محرما بفرض أو نفل بحج أو عمرة أو كانت حائضا فليست بخلوة صحيحة
cards.en: It is not a valid khalwa if one of them is ill, fasting in Ramadan, in ihram for a fard or voluntary Hajj or Umrah, or if she is in her monthly period (hayd).

cards.ask: Which of these stop a khalwa from counting?

options.text: One of them is ill
One of them is fasting in Ramadan
One of them is in ihram for Umrah
She is in her monthly period
It was in the evening

cards.source: وإن كان أحدهما مريضا أو صائما في رمضان أو محرما بفرض أو نفل بحج أو عمرة أو كانت حائضا فليست بخلوة صحيحة
cards.why: Illness, the Ramadan fast, ihram and her period each stop it being a valid khalwa. The time of day is not named.

cards.ask: Anas and his wife were alone at home, both well and with nothing in the way. Later he divorced her before dukhul. The mahr named was 800. What does she get?
cards.source: مانع من الوطء ثم طلقها فلها كمال المهر
cards.why: A valid khalwa followed by divorce gives her the full mahr.

cards.ask: Hasan and his wife were alone during a Ramadan day while he was fasting. Later he divorced her before dukhul. Was that a valid khalwa?
options: No: fasting in Ramadan stops it
Yes, if it was after Asr
cards.source: أو صائما في رمضان
cards.why: Being in the Ramadan fast is one of the things that make it not a valid khalwa.

cards.title: A husband unable to be with her
cards.ar: وإذا خلا المجبوب بامرأته ثم طلقها فلها كمال المهر عند أبي حنيفة
cards.en: If a husband who is physically unable to be with his wife (majbub) is alone with her and then divorces her, she gets the full mahr, for Abu Hanifa.

cards.title: The parting gift is recommended
cards.ar: وتستحب المتعة لكل مطلقة إلا لمطلقة واحدة وهي: التي طلقها قبل الدخول ولم يسم لها مهرا
cards.en: The mut'a (parting gift) is recommended (mustahabb) for every divorced woman except one: the one divorced before dukhul with no mahr named. For her, as the last lesson taught, the mut'a is what she is owed.

cards.ask: Nusayba was divorced after years of marriage and was paid her full mahr. Is giving her a parting gift recommended?
options: Yes: it is recommended for every divorced woman but one
No: she already has her mahr
It is owed to her as a debt
cards.source: وتستحب المتعة لكل مطلقة
cards.why: Only the woman divorced before dukhul with no mahr named is left out; for Nusayba it is recommended.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: A wife may lower her own mahr
An added mahr stays even after divorce before dukhul
A khalwa while she is in her period is valid
source: وإن حطت عنه من مهرها صح الحط
وتسقط بالطلاق قبل الدخول
أو كانت حائضا فليست بخلوة صحيحة
cards.why: Her lowering is valid. The added part falls away, and a khalwa in her period is not valid.

lessons.title: Unusual mahrs and conditions
lessons.arabic: وإذا تزوجها على حيوان غير موصوف

cards.title: One nikah as the mahr of the other
cards.ar: على أن يزوجه الرجل أخته أو ابنته ليكون أحد العقدين عوضا عن الآخر فالعقدان جائزان ولكل واحدة منهما مهر مثلها
cards.en: If one man marries his daughter to another on condition that the other marries him his sister or daughter, so that each nikah is the price of the other, both contracts are valid and each woman gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Two fathers agree: each one's daughter marries the other's son, and each nikah is the mahr for the other. What happens?
options: Both nikahs are valid, and each bride gets her mahr al-mithl
Valid, with no mahr for either
cards.source: فالعقدان جائزان ولكل واحدة منهما مهر مثلها
cards.why: Both contracts stand, and each woman is owed her mahr al-mithl.

cards.title: Service or teaching as a mahr
cards.ar: وإن تزوج حر امرأة على خدمته سنة أو على تعليم القرآن فلها مهر مثلها وإن تزوج عبد حرة بإذن مولاه على خدمتها سنة جاز
cards.en: If a free man names as the mahr a year of his service, or teaching her the Qur'an, she gets her mahr al-mithl instead. But if a slave marries a free woman, with his owner's permission, for a year of service to her, that is valid.

cards.ask: Idris, a free man, offers as his mahr to teach Amira the Qur'an. What is she owed?
cards.source: أو على تعليم القرآن فلها مهر مثلها
cards.why: Teaching the Qur'an does not stand as his mahr; she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.title: A mahr with a condition
cards.ar: وإذا تزوج امرأة على ألف درهم على أن لا يخرجها من البلد أو على أن لا يتزوج عليها فإن وفى بالشرط فلها المسمى وإن تزوج عليها أو أخرجها من البلد فلها مهر مثلها
cards.en: If he marries her for 1,000 dirhams on condition that he won't take her out of her town, or won't marry another wife, then if he keeps the condition she gets the 1,000. If he marries another or takes her away, she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Rashid married Hana for 1,000 dirhams on condition he would not move her from her town. Later he moved her to another city. What is she owed?
cards.source: وإن تزوج عليها أو أخرجها من البلد فلها مهر مثلها
cards.why: He broke the condition, so she gets her mahr al-mithl instead of the named sum.

cards.title: An animal not described
cards.ar: وإذا تزوجها على حيوان غير موصوف صحت التسمية ولها الوسط منه والزوج مخير: إن شاء أعطاها ذلك وإن شاء أعطاها قيمته
cards.en: If the mahr is an animal that is not described (say, "a horse"), the naming is valid and she gets one of middle quality. The husband may choose to give her the animal or its value.

cards.ask: Which one does she get? Complete it.
cards.ar: صحت التسمية ولها ____ منه
cards.source: صحت التسمية ولها الوسط منه
cards.why: الوسط: one of middle quality.

cards.title: A cloth not described
cards.ar: ولو تزوجها على ثوب غير موصوف فلها مهر مثلها
cards.en: But if the mahr is a cloth that is not described, she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Does the named mahr stand?
items: A free man's year of service
source: صحت التسمية ولها الوسط منه
فإن وفى بالشرط فلها المسمى
ولو تزوجها على ثوب غير موصوف فلها مهر مثلها
على خدمته سنة أو على تعليم القرآن فلها مهر مثلها
cards.why: An undescribed animal and a kept condition stand. An undescribed cloth, a free man's service and Qur'an teaching give her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Uthman names "a camel" as the mahr, without describing it. What may he give?
options: A camel of middle quality, or its value
cards.source: ولها الوسط منه والزوج مخير: إن شاء أعطاها ذلك وإن شاء أعطاها قيمته
cards.why: The naming is valid: she gets a middle one, and he chooses between the animal and its value.

cards.title: An enslaved person's nikah
cards.ar: ولا يجوز نكاح العبد والأمة إلا بإذن مولاهما وإذا تزوج العبد بإذن مولاه فالمهر دين في رقبته يباع فيه
cards.en: An enslaved man ('abd) or woman (ama) may marry only with the owner's (mawla's) permission. If the man marries with permission, the mahr is a debt on him, and he may be sold to pay it.

cards.title: An ama's home
cards.ar: وإذا زوج المولى أمته فليس عليه أن يبوئها بيت الزوج ولكنها تخدم المولى ويقال للزوج: متى ظفرت بها وطئتها
cards.en: If an owner marries off his ama, he does not have to give her a home with her husband. She keeps serving the owner, and the husband is told he may be with her whenever he can.

cards.title: Mut'a and fixed-term marriage are void
cards.ar: ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
