cards.en: Nikah al-mut'a (a "marriage" for enjoyment for a set time) and a nikah for a fixed period are void (batil): they are not a marriage at all.

cards.ask: A man offers a woman a nikah "for one month only". What is it?
options: Void: a fixed-term nikah is batil
Valid, but becomes a normal nikah
cards.source: ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
cards.why: A nikah limited to a time is void.

cards.title: Pending until approved
cards.ar: وتزويج العبد والأمة بغير إذن مولاهما موقوف: فإن أجازه المولى جاز وإن رده بطل وكذلك لو زوج امرأة بغير رضاها أو رجلا بغير رضاه
cards.en: A nikah of an enslaved person without the owner's permission is mawquf: on hold. If the owner approves it, it is valid; if he rejects it, it is void. The same is true when someone marries off a woman or a man without their consent.

cards.ask: Hamza is an adult. His uncle arranges a nikah for him without asking him. When Hamza hears, he gladly approves. What is the nikah?
options: Valid: it was pending and he approved it
Valid only if his father approves
cards.source: وكذلك لو زوج امرأة بغير رضاها أو رجلا بغير رضاه
cards.why: A nikah made without his consent waits on him. His approval makes it valid.

cards.title: A choice when she is freed
cards.ar: وإذا زوج الأمة مولاها ثم أعتقت فلها الخيار حرا كان زوجها أو عبدا وكذلك المكاتبة
cards.en: If an ama's owner married her off and she is later freed, she has a choice to stay or leave, whether her husband is free or enslaved. The same holds for a mukataba (a woman buying her freedom by installments).

cards.title: No choice if she married herself
cards.ar: بغير إذن مولاها ثم أعتقت صح النكاح ولا خيار لها
cards.en: If an ama married without her owner's permission and was then freed, the nikah becomes valid and she has no choice.

cards.ask: An ama was married by her owner to a free man. Later she is set free. Does she have a choice about the marriage?
options: Yes: she has a choice whether he is free or not
Only if her husband is a slave
cards.source: ثم أعتقت فلها الخيار حرا كان زوجها أو عبدا
cards.why: Once freed, she has the choice whatever her husband's status.

cards.ask: Valid, void or pending?
items: A nikah for one year only
An adult woman married off without her consent
An 'abd marrying without his owner's permission
An 'abd marrying with his owner's permission
source: ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
وتزويج العبد والأمة بغير إذن مولاهما موقوف
وإذا تزوج العبد بإذن مولاه
cards.why: Mut'a and fixed-term are void. Without consent or permission it is pending. With permission it is valid.

cards.ask: Which of these is mawquf (pending) rather than void?
options: A woman married off without her consent
A nikah for a fixed time
source: وكذلك لو زوج امرأة بغير رضاها
ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
cards.why: Marrying someone off without consent waits on their approval. Mut'a and fixed-term are void.

cards.title: A wali guaranteeing the mahr
cards.ar: وإذا ضمن الولي المهر صح ضمانه وللمرأة الخيار في مطالبة زوجها أو وليها
cards.en: If the wali guarantees the mahr, the guarantee is valid, and the wife may ask either her husband or the wali for it.

cards.ask: Sana's father guaranteed her mahr. The husband has not paid. Whom may Sana ask?
options: Either her husband or her father
cards.source: وللمرأة الخيار في مطالبة زوجها أو وليها
cards.why: The guarantee is valid, so she may claim from either.

cards.title: A defective (fasid) nikah
cards.ar: وإذا فرق القاضي بين الزوجين في النكاح الفاسد قبل الدخول فلا مهر لها وكذلك بعد الخلوة وإن دخل بها فلها مهر مثلها لا يزاد على المسمى وعليها العدة ويثبت نسب ولدها
cards.en: A fasid nikah is one with a defect that spoils it. If the qadi (judge) separates the couple before dukhul, she gets no mahr, and the same after only khalwa. If there was dukhul, she gets her mahr al-mithl, but no more than what was named. She keeps the iddah, and her child's lineage is established.

cards.ask: A qadi separates a couple in a fasid nikah. They had been alone together, but there was no dukhul. What mahr is owed?
cards.source: قبل الدخول فلا مهر لها وكذلك بعد الخلوة
cards.why: In a fasid nikah, khalwa alone gives no mahr.

cards.ask: In a fasid nikah, 500 dirhams was named and there was dukhul. Her mahr al-mithl would be 800. What is she owed?
cards.source: وإن دخل بها فلها مهر مثلها لا يزاد على المسمى
cards.why: She gets her mahr al-mithl, but not more than the named 500.

cards.title: Whose mahr is compared
cards.ar: ومهر مثلها يعتبر بأخواتها وعماتها
cards.en: Her mahr al-mithl is measured by the mahr of her sisters, her father's sisters and her father's brothers' daughters. It is not measured by her mother or her mother's sister if they are not from her father's tribe.

cards.ask: Asiya's mother is from a different tribe than her father. To find Asiya's mahr al-mithl, whose mahr is looked at?
source: ومهر مثلها يعتبر بأخواتها وعماتها
ولا يعتبر بأمها وخالتها إذا لم يكونا من قبيلتها
cards.why: The women of her father's side are the measure. Her mother and maternal aunt are not, as they are of another tribe.

cards.title: How alike the women must be
cards.ar: ويعتبر في مهر المثل: أن تتساوى المرأتان في السن والجمال والعفة والمال والعقل والدين والبلد والعصر
cards.en: To compare, the two women must be alike in age, beauty, chastity, wealth, intelligence, religion, town and time.

cards.ask: In what must the two women be alike for mahr al-mithl?

options.text: Age
Religion
Town
Intelligence
Height
Number of brothers

cards.source: أن تتساوى المرأتان في السن والجمال والعفة والمال والعقل والدين والبلد والعصر
cards.why: Age, beauty, chastity, wealth, intelligence, religion, town and era. Height and brothers are not named.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: In a fasid nikah after dukhul, the child's lineage is established
After a fasid nikah she keeps no iddah
A wali's guarantee of the mahr is void
source: وعليها العدة ويثبت نسب ولدها
وإذا ضمن الولي المهر صح ضمانه
cards.why: She keeps the iddah and the child's lineage is established. The wali's guarantee is valid.

cards.title: Marrying an ama
cards.ar: ويجوز تزويج الأمة مسلمة كانت أو كتابية ولا يجوز أن يتزوج أمة على حرة ويجوز الحرة عليها
cards.en: A man may marry an enslaved woman (ama), Muslim or of the People of the Book. But he may not marry an ama while already married to a free woman. He may marry a free woman while married to an ama.

cards.ask: Yasir is married to a free woman. May he now marry an ama as well?
options: No: not an ama on top of a free wife
cards.source: ولا يجوز أن يتزوج أمة على حرة
cards.why: Al-Quduri forbids marrying an ama on top of a free wife.

cards.title: Four, or two
cards.ar: وللحر أن يتزوج أربعا من الحرائر والإماء وليس له أن يتزوج أكثر من ذلك ولا يتزوج العبد أكثر من اثنتين
cards.en: A free man may marry up to four wives, free or not, and no more. An enslaved man may not marry more than two.

cards.ask: How many for an enslaved man? Complete it.
cards.ar: ولا يتزوج العبد أكثر من ____
cards.source: ولا يتزوج العبد أكثر من اثنتين
cards.why: اثنتين: no more than two.

cards.title: Waiting for the iddah
cards.ar: فإن طلق الحر إحدى الأربع طلاقا بائنا لم يجز له أن يتزوج رابعة حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.en: If a free man gives one of his four wives a ba'in divorce, he may not marry another fourth wife until her iddah is over.

cards.ask: Ibrahim has four wives. He gives one a ba'in divorce, and her iddah has not ended. May he marry another woman now?
options: No: not until her iddah ends
Yes: a ba'in divorce ends the marriage
Yes, if the other wives agree
cards.source: لم يجز له أن يتزوج رابعة حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.why: He must wait for the divorced wife's iddah to end before taking a new fourth wife.

cards.ask: May he marry now?
items: A free man with three wives
A free man with four wives
An enslaved man with two wives
A free man whose fourth wife is in her iddah after a ba'in divorce
A man married to an ama, marrying a free woman
source: وللحر أن يتزوج أربعا
ولا يتزوج العبد أكثر من اثنتين
حتى تنقضي عدتها
ويجوز الحرة عليها
cards.why: Three wives leaves room for a fourth. Four is the limit for a free man, two for an enslaved man. During the iddah he waits.

cards.ask: Musa, a free man, has three wives. May he marry a fourth?
options: Yes: a free man may have up to four
cards.source: وللحر أن يتزوج أربعا من الحرائر والإماء
cards.why: A free man may marry up to four.

cards.ask: Which is allowed?
options: Marrying a free woman while married to an ama
Marrying an ama while married to a free woman
A free man marrying a fifth wife
source: ولا يجوز أن يتزوج أمة على حرة ويجوز الحرة عليها
وليس له أن يتزوج أكثر من ذلك
cards.why: A free woman may be added to an ama, not the other way. More than four is never allowed.

lessons.title: Defects and the right to separate
lessons.arabic: فإن كان عنينا أجله الحاكم حولا

cards.title: A defect gives no choice
cards.ar: وإن كان بالزوجة عيب فلا خيار لزوجها وإذا كان بالزوج جنون أو جذام أو برص فلا خيار للمرأة عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: لها الخيار
cards.en: If the wife has a defect, the husband has no choice to cancel the nikah. If the husband has insanity, leprosy (judham) or white skin patches (baras), the wife has no choice either, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad says she has the choice.

cards.ask: After the nikah, Imran learns his wife has a long-standing illness. May he have the nikah cancelled for it?
options: No: a defect in the wife gives him no choice
Yes: any defect gives a choice
cards.source: وإن كان بالزوجة عيب فلا خيار لزوجها
cards.why: Al-Quduri says a defect in the wife gives the husband no choice.

cards.title: A husband unable to be intimate
cards.ar: فإن كان عنينا أجله الحاكم حولا فإن وصل إليها وإلا فرق بينهما إن طلبت المرأة ذلك
cards.en: If the husband is 'innin (unable to be intimate with his wife), the judge gives him a hawl: one full year. If he is able in that time, the marriage stays. If not, the judge separates them if the wife asks for it.

cards.ask: How long is he given? Complete it.
cards.ar: فإن كان عنينا أجله الحاكم ____
cards.source: فإن كان عنينا أجله الحاكم حولا
cards.why: حولا: a full year.

cards.title: A final separation
cards.ar: والفرقة تطليقه بائنة ولها كمال المهر إن كان قد خلا بها
cards.en: The separation counts as a ba'in divorce (final), and she gets the full mahr if they had been alone together (khalwa).

cards.ask: Sakina's husband was given a year by the judge and was still unable. She asks for separation, and they had been alone together. What happens?
options: They are separated by a ba'in divorce, and she gets the full mahr
They are separated, with no mahr
source: وإلا فرق بينهما إن طلبت المرأة ذلك
والفرقة تطليقه بائنة ولها كمال المهر إن كان قد خلا بها
cards.why: After the year the judge separates them at her request. It is a ba'in divorce with the full mahr after khalwa.

cards.title: A eunuch is given the year too
cards.ar: والخصي يؤجل كما يؤجل العنين
cards.en: A khasi (a man who has been castrated) is given the same one-year delay as the 'innin.

cards.ask: Does the wife have a way to separate?
items: He is 'innin and the year passed
He is a khasi and the year passed
source: وإلا فرق بينهما إن طلبت المرأة ذلك
والخصي يؤجل كما يؤجل العنين
أو جذام أو برص فلا خيار للمرأة
cards.why: An 'innin or khasi after the year: she may ask. For judham or baras she has no choice, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf.

cards.ask: Who decides the year for an 'innin husband?
cards.source: أجله الحاكم حولا
cards.why: The judge sets the year and, if she asks, separates them.

cards.title: The wife becomes Muslim
cards.ar: وزوجها كافر عرض عليه القاضي الإسلام فإن أسلم فهي امرأته وإن أبى عن الإسلام فرق بينهما وكان ذلك طلاقا بائنا عند أبي حنيفة ومحمد: وقال أبو يوسف: هي فرقة بغير طلاق
cards.en: If a wife becomes Muslim and her husband is not, the qadi invites him to Islam. If he accepts, she stays his wife. If he refuses, they are separated, and that counts as a ba'in divorce for Abu Hanifa and Muhammad. Note: Abu Yusuf says it is a separation without divorce.

cards.title: The husband becomes Muslim, his wife is Majusi
cards.ar: فإن أسلم الزوج وتحته مجوسية عرض عليها الإسلام فإن أسلمت فهي امرأته وإن أبت فرق القاضي بينهما ولم تكن هذه الفرقة طلاقا
cards.en: If the husband becomes Muslim and his wife is Majusi, she is invited to Islam. If she accepts, she stays his wife. If she refuses, the qadi separates them, and this separation is not a divorce. If there was dukhul she keeps her mahr; if not, she has no mahr.

cards.title: The husband of a kitabiyya
cards.ar: وإذا أسلم زوج الكتابية فهما على نكاحهما
cards.en: If the husband of a Jewish or Christian wife becomes Muslim, their nikah carries on.

cards.ask: Daniel becomes Muslim. His wife Ruth stays Christian. What happens to their marriage?
cards.source: وإذا أسلم زوج الكتابية فهما على نكاحهما
cards.why: A Muslim may be married to a kitabiyya, so their nikah continues.

cards.ask: Kaveh becomes Muslim. His Majusi wife is invited to Islam and declines. There had been no dukhul. What happens?
options: They are separated, with no mahr
They are separated, and she gets half the mahr
source: وإن أبت فرق القاضي بينهما
وإن لم يكن دخل بها فلا مهر لها
cards.why: The qadi separates them, not as a divorce, and with no dukhul she has no mahr.

cards.title: In dar al-harb
cards.ar: وإذا أسلمت المرأة في دار الحرب لم تقع الفرقة عليها حتى تحيض ثلاث حيض فإذا حاضت بانت من زوجها
cards.en: Dar al-harb is a land at war with the Muslims, outside Muslim rule. If a woman becomes Muslim there, the separation does not happen until she has had three monthly periods. When she has, she is parted from her husband.

cards.title: Leaving dar al-harb
cards.ar: وإذا خرج أحد الزوجين إلينا من دار الحرب مسلما وقعت البينونة بينهما
cards.en: If one spouse comes over from dar al-harb to Muslim lands as a Muslim, the marriage ends between them. If both were captured together, it does not end.

cards.title: A woman who migrates
cards.ar: وإذا خرجت المرأة إلينا مهاجرة جاز لها أن تتزوج ولا عدة عليها عند أبي حنيفة فإن كانت حاملا لم تتزوج حتى تضع حملها
cards.en: If a woman comes over to Muslim lands as a muhajira (migrant for her faith), she may marry, and for Abu Hanifa she keeps no iddah. But if she is pregnant, she may not marry until she gives birth.

cards.ask: Amina migrated alone to Muslim lands as a Muslim, leaving her husband behind. She is expecting a baby. When may she marry?
cards.source: فإن كانت حاملا لم تتزوج حتى تضع حملها
cards.why: A pregnant muhajira waits until the birth.

cards.ask: Does the marriage carry on?
items: Husband becomes Muslim, wife stays Christian
Wife becomes Muslim, husband accepts Islam
Wife becomes Muslim, husband refuses Islam
Husband becomes Muslim, Majusi wife refuses Islam
source: فهما على نكاحهما
فإن أسلم فهي امرأته وإن أبى عن الإسلام فرق بينهما
وإن أبت فرق القاضي بينهما
وإن سبيا معا لم تقع البينونة
cards.why: A kitabiyya wife, an accepting husband, or capture together: it carries on. A refusal of Islam leads to separation.

cards.ask: Complete it.
cards.ar: وإذا أسلم زوج ____ فهما على نكاحهما
cards.source: وإذا أسلم زوج الكتابية فهما على نكاحهما
cards.why: الكتابية: the wife of the Book may stay married to a Muslim.

cards.ask: A woman becomes Muslim in dar al-harb. When is she parted from her husband?
cards.source: لم تقع الفرقة عليها حتى تحيض ثلاث حيض
cards.why: In dar al-harb, the separation comes after three periods.

lessons.title: Leaving Islam, and the children's religion

cards.title: If a spouse leaves Islam
cards.ar: أحد الزوجين عن الإسلام وقعت الفرقة بينهما بغير طلاق
cards.en: Ridda means leaving Islam, and one who does so is a murtadd. If either spouse leaves Islam, the marriage ends at once, without a divorce.

cards.title: The mahr after ridda
cards.ar: فإن كان الزوج هو المرتد وقد دخل بها فلها كمال المهر وإن كان لم يدخل بها فلها نصف المهر وإن كانت المرأة هي المرتدة فإن كان قبل الدخول فلا مهر لها وإن كانت الردة بعد الدخول فلها المهر وإن ارتدا معا وأسلما فهما على نكاحهما
cards.en: If the husband left Islam: after dukhul she gets the full mahr, before it half. If the wife left Islam: before dukhul she has no mahr, after it she keeps the mahr. If both left together and both returned to Islam, their nikah carries on.

cards.ask: What mahr is owed?
cards.source: فإن كان الزوج هو المرتد وقد دخل بها فلها كمال المهر وإن كان لم يدخل بها فلها نصف المهر وإن كانت المرأة هي المرتدة فإن كان قبل الدخول فلا مهر لها وإن كانت الردة بعد الدخول فلها المهر
cards.why: After dukhul the mahr is hers in full. Before dukhul it is half if he left Islam, and none if she did.

cards.title: No nikah for a murtadd
cards.ar: ولا يجوز أن يتزوج المرتد مسلمة ولا كافرة ولا مرتدة وكذلك المرتدة لا يتزوجها مسلم ولا كافر ولا مرتد
cards.en: A man who has left Islam may not marry a Muslim, a non-Muslim, or another murtadd. Likewise no one may marry a woman who has left Islam.

cards.title: The children's religion
cards.ar: وإذا كان أحد الزوجين مسلما فالولد على دينه وكذلك إن أسلم أحدهما وله ولد صغير صار ولده مسلما بإسلامه وإن كان أحد الأبوين كتابيا والآخر مجوسيا فالولد كتابي
cards.en: If one parent is Muslim, the child follows that parent's religion. So if one parent becomes Muslim and has a young child, the child becomes Muslim too. If one parent is of the Book and the other Majusi, the child counts as of the Book.

cards.ask: Yaqub's father becomes Muslim; his mother does not. Yaqub is six. What is Yaqub's religion in fiqh?
options: He has none until he is grown
cards.source: وكذلك إن أسلم أحدهما وله ولد صغير صار ولده مسلما بإسلامه
cards.why: A young child becomes Muslim with the parent who becomes Muslim.

cards.ask: A child's mother is Christian and the father is Majusi. How is the child counted?
cards.source: وإن كان أحد الأبوين كتابيا والآخر مجوسيا فالولد كتابي
cards.why: With one parent of the Book and one Majusi, the child is counted as kitabi.

cards.title: Marriages made before Islam
cards.ar: وإذا تزوج الكافر بغير شهود أو في عدة الكافر وذلك في دينهم
cards.en: If a non-Muslim couple married without witnesses, or during an iddah from a non-Muslim, and their religion allowed it, then both became Muslim, they are left in that marriage. But if a Majusi had married his mother or daughter and then they became Muslim, they are separated.

cards.ask: Before Islam, Peter and Martha married with no witnesses, as their religion allowed. Now both have become Muslim. What about their marriage?
options: It is left as it is
They must redo the nikah with witnesses
source: وإذا تزوج الكافر بغير شهود
ثم أسلما أقرا عليه
cards.why: Their earlier marriage is accepted once they both become Muslim.

cards.ask: A married couple both leave Islam together and later both return to Islam. What about their nikah?
cards.source: وإن ارتدا معا وأسلما فهما على نكاحهما
cards.why: If they left together and returned together, the book keeps them on their nikah.

cards.title: Being fair
cards.ar: وإذا كان للرجل امرأتان حرتان
cards.en: If a man has two free wives, he must be fair between them in qasm: sharing his nights between them equally.

cards.title: Old or new, the same
cards.ar: بينهما في القسم بكرين كانتا أو ثيبتين أو إحداهما بكرا والأخرى ثيبا
cards.en: This is so whether both were never married before (bikr), both were married before (thayyib), or one of each.

cards.ask: Harun marries Ruqayya (a bikr) while already married to Khadija (a thayyib). How should he share his nights?
cards.source: بينهما في القسم بكرين كانتا أو ثيبتين أو إحداهما بكرا والأخرى ثيبا
cards.why: Bikr or thayyib, the turns are equal.

cards.title: A free wife and an ama
cards.ar: فللحرة الثلثان من القسم وللأمة الثلث
cards.en: If one wife is free and the other an ama, the free wife has two thirds of the turns and the ama one third.

cards.ask: A man's wives are a free woman and an ama. Over 3 nights, how many are the free wife's?
cards.source: فللحرة الثلثان من القسم وللأمة الثلث
cards.why: The free wife has two thirds: 2 of every 3 nights.

cards.title: On a journey
cards.ar: ولا حق لهن في القسم حالة السفر ويسافر الزوج بمن شاء منهن
cards.en: On a journey the wives have no right to turns: the husband may travel with whichever of them he wishes. It is better that he draws lots and travels with the one whose lot comes out.

cards.ask: Zubayr is going on a journey and can take one wife. What does al-Quduri say is best?
options: Draw lots and take the one whose lot comes out
Take each in turn, by the calendar
source: ويسافر الزوج بمن شاء منهن
فيسافر بمن خرجت قرعتها
cards.why: He may take whom he wishes, but drawing lots is better.

cards.title: Giving up a turn
cards.ar: وإن رضيت الزوجات بترك قسمها لصاحبتها جاز ولها أن ترجع في ذلك
cards.en: If a wife is happy to give her turn to the other wife, that is allowed, and she may take it back later.

cards.ask: Hafsa gave her nights to her co-wife. Months later she wants them back. May she?
options: Yes: she may take it back
No: a gift cannot be undone
cards.source: ولها أن ترجع في ذلك
cards.why: Al-Quduri says she may go back on giving up her turn.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: Wives have no right to turns during a journey
A bikr wife gets more nights than a thayyib
A free wife and an ama share nights equally
source: ولا حق لهن في القسم حالة السفر
بكرين كانتا أو ثيبتين
فللحرة الثلثان من القسم وللأمة الثلث
cards.why: Turns stop on a journey. Bikr and thayyib are equal, and the free wife has two thirds.
